summary: We find that LoRA fine-tuning exhibits un-learning on contested examples: items with high annotator disagreement show increasing loss during training, a qualitatively distinct pattern largely absent under full fine-tuning and consistent across all six models tested (four encoder, two decoder-only). This discovery emerges from correlating annotation entropy, computed from ChaosNLI's 100 labels per example, with per-example area under the loss curve (AULC) on SNLI and MNLI. The correlation is positive in all 25 conditions tested (Spearman $ρ= 0.06$-$0.43$), with decoder-only models showing stronger correlations than encoders at matched LoRA rank. The effect survives partial-correlation controls and replicates across seeds and datasets. A preliminary noise-injection experiment is consistent with these findings.

AI.tldr: LoRA微调会对"争议样本"（标注一致性低的样本）产生"遗忘"现象，这些样本在训练过程中损失反而上升。该现象在6种模型、25种条件下均稳定出现，decoder-only模型比encoder模型表现更明显。
AI.motivation: 理解LoRA微调对标注质量不均衡数据的处理特性，特别是当训练样本存在标注歧义时的学习行为。
AI.method: 利用ChaosNLI的每样本100个标注计算标注熵，与SNLI/MNLI上每个样本的损失曲线下面积(AULC)做相关性分析。实验涵盖6种模型、25种条件，并进行偏相关控制和噪声注入验证。
AI.result: 所有25种条件下均呈正相关(Spearman ρ=0.06-0.43)，decoder-only模型相关性更强于encoder。该效应通过偏相关控制验证，并可跨种子和数据集复现。
AI.conclusion: LoRA微调对争议样本存在系统性遗忘倾向，这一发现对理解模型微调行为和数据集构建策略具有重要意义。

title: Political and Ideological Pressure in Software Engineering Research: The Case of DEI Backlash
comment: ICSE 2026, Future of Software Engineering (FoSE) track
summary: Political and ideological pressures shape global research. Recently, these pressures have become particularly visible in research related to diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI). Drastic changes in national funding and governmental guidance, especially in the US, have affected the global software engineering research ecosystem. The impacts of these pressures on research are not always direct, as they operate at multiple levels. However, what is clear is that these pressures affect every field, including software engineering (SE), despite the belief that our field is politically and ideologically neutral. In this position paper, we examine cases of political and ideological pressures on the SE research ecosystem. We investigate the community's perceptions of political and ideological pressures by analyzing community survey responses and outlining case examples of DEI backlash in SE research across three levels: macro, meso, and micro. Our research shows how recent political and ideological pressures have affected SE research across these levels, and, as a result, we propose actionable steps for the community to address these issues at different levels.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨政治和意识形态压力如何影响软件工程研究生态系统，重点关注DEI相关研究。通过社区调查和案例分析，从宏观、中观、微观三个层面揭示这些压力对SE研究的影响，并提出应对建议。
AI.motivation: 研究动机：近年来政治和意识形态压力对全球研究的影响日益显著，特别是DEI相关研究领域。美国等国家在资金和政策法规层面的剧烈变化已波及软件工程研究社区，而该领域常被认为具有"政治中立性"。
AI.method: 研究方法：1) 社区调查问卷，收集学界对政治和意识形态压力的感知；2) 多层面案例分析，涵盖宏观(国家政策)、中观(机构/资助方)、微观(个体研究者)三个层级；3) 立场论文形式的综述与建议。
AI.result: 核心发现：DEI研究面临明显回潮压力，这些压力通过多种渠道传导至SE研究；政治意识形态压力实际影响了该领域的研究议程、人员配置和学术交流，尽管SE常被视为"中立"领域。
AI.conclusion: 结论与建议：提出针对不同层级的可操作措施，旨在帮助SE研究社区应对政治和意识形态压力对学术研究生态系统的影响，维护研究的多样性与包容性。

title: Brain-CLIPLM: Decoding Compressed Semantic Representations in EEG for Language Reconstruction
summary: Decoding natural language from non-invasive electroencephalography (EEG) remains fundamentally limited by low signal-to-noise ratio and restricted information bandwidth. This raises a fundamental question regarding whether sentence-level linguistic structure can be reliably recovered from such signals. In this work, we suggest that this assumption may not hold under realistic information constraints, and instead propose a semantic compression hypothesis in which EEG signals encode a compressed set of semantic anchors rather than full linguistic structure. Under our new perspective, direct sentence reconstruction becomes an overparameterized objective relative to the intrinsic information capacity of EEG. To address this mismatch, we introduce Brain-CLIPLM, a two-stage framework that decomposes EEG-to-text decoding into semantic anchor extraction via contrastive learning and sentence reconstruction using a retrieval-grounded large language model (LLM) with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, following a granularity matching principle that aligns decoding complexity with neural information capacity. Evaluated on the Zurich Cognitive Language Processing Corpus, Brain-CLIPLM achieves 67.55\% top-5 and 85.00\% top-25 sentence retrieval accuracy, significantly outperforming direct decoding baseline, while cross-subject evaluation confirms robust generalization. Control analyses, including permutation testing, further demonstrate that EEG-derived representations carry sentence-specific information beyond language model priors. These results suggest that EEG-to-text decoding is better framed as recovering compressed semantic content rather than reconstructing full sentences, providing a biologically grounded and data-efficient pathway for non-invasive brain-computer interfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语义压缩假说，认为EEG信号编码的是压缩的语义锚点而非完整语言结构，并据此提出两阶段框架Brain-CLIPLM，在ZuCo语料库上实现67.55% top-5和85.00% top-25检索准确率，显著优于直接解码基线。
AI.motivation: 非侵入式脑电图(EEG)的低信噪比和有限信息带宽限制了自然语言解码。研究质疑在现实信息约束下是否能从EEG信号中可靠恢复句子级语言结构。
AI.method: 提出语义压缩假说，并设计Brain-CLIPLM两阶段框架：第一阶段通过对比学习提取语义锚点，第二阶段使用检索增强的LLM结合思维链(CoT)推理进行句子重建。遵循粒度匹配原则，将解码复杂度与神经信息容量对齐。
AI.result: 在ZuCo语料库上达到67.55% top-5和85.00% top-25句子检索准确率，显著优于直接解码基线。跨被试评估确认良好的泛化能力。置换检验等控制分析表明EEG衍生表征携带超越语言模型先验的句子特异性信息。
AI.conclusion: EEG到文本的解码应被更好地理解为恢复压缩的语义内容而非重建完整句子。这为非侵入式脑机接口提供了一条符合生物学原理且数据高效的路径。

title: Computational Hermeneutics: Evaluating generative AI as a cultural technology
comment: Published in Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence
summary: Generative AI systems are increasingly recognized as cultural technologies, yet current evaluation frameworks often treat culture as a variable to be measured rather than fundamental to the system's operation. Drawing on hermeneutic theory from the humanities, we argue that GenAI systems function as "context machines" that must inherently address three interpretive challenges: situatedness (meaning only emerges in context), plurality (multiple valid interpretations coexist), and ambiguity (interpretations naturally conflict). We present computational hermeneutics as an emerging framework offering an interpretive account of what GenAI systems do, and how they might do it better. We offer three principles for hermeneutic evaluation -- that benchmarks should be iterative, not one-off; include people, not just machines; and measure cultural context, not just model output. This perspective offers a nascent paradigm for designing and evaluating contemporary AI systems: shifting from standardized questions about accuracy to contextual ones about meaning.

AI.tldr: 本文将GenAI定位为"文化技术"，借鉴解释学理论提出计算解释学框架，认为GenAI系统本质上是必须处理情境性、多元性和模糊性的"语境机器"。文章提出三个评估原则：基准测试需迭代化、需纳入人类评估者、需测量文化语境而非仅输出准确性，从而推动AI评估范式从标准化准确性转向情境化意义评估。
AI.motivation: 现有评估框架将文化视为待测量的变量，而非系统运作的基础组成部分，忽视了GenAI作为文化技术的本质特征。
AI.method: 借鉴人文科学的解释学理论，将GenAI系统概念化为"语境机器"，提出包含三个原则的计算解释学框架：基准测试应是迭代的而非一次性的、应纳入人类而非仅机器、应测量文化语境而非仅模型输出。
AI.result: 系统提出GenAI必须应对的三个解释学挑战——情境性（意义仅在语境中产生）、多元性（多种有效解释共存）、模糊性（解释自然冲突），并建立三个解释学评估原则。
AI.conclusion: 提出计算解释学作为新兴范式，将AI评估从标准化的准确性评估转向情境化的意义评估。

title: HieraSparse: Hierarchical Semi-Structured Sparse KV Attention
summary: The deployment of long-context Large Language Models (LLMs) poses significant challenges due to the intense computational cost of self-attention and the substantial memory overhead of the Key-Value Cache (KV Cache). In this paper, we introduce HieraSparse, a hierarchical KV Cache compression framework with acceleration kernels that leverage GPU sparse tensor cores to speed up semi-structured KV Cache attention for both the prefill and decode phases. With the hierarchical design, our method allows for a flexible quality-sparsity trade-off and successfully converts sparsity into efficiency. Compared to the state-of-the-art decode method that utilizes unstructured sparsity, HieraSparse achieves $\mathbf{1.2\times}$ KV compression ratio and $\mathbf{4.57\times}$ attention speedup at the same sparsity level. Furthermore, we extended the semi-structured KV Cache pruning to the prefill stage, which demonstrated up to $\mathbf{1.85\times}$ attention speedup at the highest sparsity. Lastly, we evaluate the generation quality of HieraSparse with a simple magnitude-based pruning method, and the results show that $\mathbf{1.37\times}$ prefill speedup and $\mathbf{1.77\times}$ decode speedup can be achieved without significant quality drop. The codebase can be found at https://github.com/psl-ntu/HieraSparse.

AI.tldr: HieraSparse是一种层次化KV Cache压缩框架，利用GPU稀疏张量核加速半结构化KV Cache注意力计算，在相同稀疏度下实现1.2×压缩比和4.57×注意力加速，预fill阶段可达1.85×加速，整体无明显质量下降。
AI.motivation: 长上下文LLM部署面临挑战：自注意力计算成本高、KV Cache内存开销大。
AI.method: 提出HieraSparse框架：层次化KV Cache压缩设计 + GPU稀疏张量核加速内核，支持prefill和decode阶段的半结构化KV Cache稀疏注意力。
AI.result: 相比SOTA非结构化稀疏方法：1.2× KV压缩比、4.57×注意力加速；prefill阶段最高1.85×加速； magnitude剪枝下1.37× prefill加速、1.77× decode加速。
AI.conclusion: 层次化设计实现灵活的质量-稀疏度权衡，有效将稀疏性转化为计算效率提升。

title: Flow Shop Scheduling with Stochastic Reentry
summary: We study flow shop scheduling with stochastic reentry, where jobs must complete multiple passes through the entire shop, and the number of passes that a job requires for completion is drawn from a discrete probability distribution. The goal is to find policies that minimize performance measures in expectation. Our main contribution is a reduction to a classical parallel machine scheduling problem augmented with machine arrivals. This reduction preserves expected objective values and enables transferring structural results and performance guarantees from the auxiliary problems to the reentrant flow shop setting. We demonstrate the usefulness of this reduction by proving the optimality of simple priority policies for minimizing the makespan and the total completion time in expectation under geometric and, more generally, monotone hazard rate distributions. For minimizing the total weighted completion time, we derive an approximation guarantee that depends only on the squared coefficient of variation of the underlying distributions for a simple priority policy. Our results constitute the first optimality and approximation guarantees for flow shops with stochastic reentry and demonstrate that established scheduling policies naturally extend to this setting through the proposed reduction.

AI.tldr: 本文研究具有随机重入的回流车间调度问题，将该问题归约为带机器到达的并行机调度问题，并基于此证明了简单优先级策略在特定分布下的最优性或近似最优性。
AI.motivation: 回流车间调度在实际生产系统（如半导体制造）中普遍存在，但现有研究多集中于确定性重入次数，对于随机重入情况缺乏理论性能保证。
AI.method: 提出一种归约方法：将随机重入次数的回流车间问题等价转换为带机器到达的并行机调度问题，从而借用成熟的结果框架。
AI.result: 1. 对数正态和单调风险率分布，使简单优先级策略在最小化期望makespan和总完工时间时最优；2. 对加权总完工时间，给出仅依赖于分布变异系数平方的近似比。
AI.conclusion: 该归约为随机重入调度问题提供了首个最优性/近似保证，证明了经典调度策略可自然推广至此设置。

title: Logic-Based Verification of Task Allocation for LLM-Enabled Multi-Agent Manufacturing Systems
summary: Manufacturing industries are facing increasing product variability due to the growing demand for personalized products. Under these conditions, ensuring safety becomes challenging as frequent reconfigurations can lead to unintended hazardous behaviors. Multi-agent control architectures have been proposed to improve flexibility through decentralized decision-making and coordination. However, these architectures are based on predefined task models, which limit their ability to adapt task planning to new product requirements while preserving safety. Recently, large language models have been introduced into manufacturing systems to enhance adaptability, but reliability remains a key challenge. To address this issue, we propose a control architecture that leverages the flexibility of large language models while preserving safety on the manufacturing shop floor. Specifically, the proposed framework verifies large language model-enabled task allocations by using temporal logic and discrete event systems. The effectiveness of the proposed framework is demonstrated through a case study that involves a multi-robot assembly scenario, showing that unsafe tasks can be allocated safely before task execution.

AI.tldr: 论文针对制造业中个性化产品需求带来的安全挑战，提出了一种结合大语言模型灵活性与形式化安全验证的控制架构。该框架使用时序逻辑和离散事件系统对LLM生成的任务分配进行安全验证，并通过多机器人装配场景验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 制造业面临个性化产品需求带来的频繁重新配置挑战，传统多智能体控制架构依赖预定义任务模型，无法适应新生产需求；大语言模型虽增强了适应性，但可靠性（安全性）问题尚未解决。
AI.method: 提出一种控制架构框架，结合LLM的灵活性与形式化安全验证方法。具体采用时序逻辑（Temporal Logic）和离散事件系统（Discrete Event Systems）对LLM生成的任务分配进行验证，确保任务执行前的安全性。
AI.result: 通过多机器人装配场景的案例研究验证了框架有效性，证明不安全的任务可以在执行前被识别并安全分配。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功将LLM的适应能力与形式化安全验证相结合，为制造业灵活生产提供了安全保障方案，具有实际应用价值。

title: GRAB-ANNS: High-Throughput Indexing and Hybrid Search via GPU-Native Bucketing
summary: Hybrid search, which jointly optimizes vector similarity and structured predicate filtering, has become a fundamental building block for modern AI-driven systems. While recent predicate-aware ANN indices improve filtering efficiency on CPUs, their performance is increasingly constrained by limited memory bandwidth and parallelism. Although GPUs offer massive parallelism and superior memory bandwidth, directly porting CPU-centric hybrid search algorithms to GPUs leads to severe performance degradation due to architectural mismatches, including irregular memory access, branch divergence, and excessive CPU-GPU synchronization. In this paper, we present GRAB-ANNS, a high-throughput, GPU-native graph index for dynamic hybrid search. Our key insight is to rethink hybrid indexing from a hardware-first perspective. We introduce a bucket-based memory layout that transforms range predicates into lightweight bucket selection, enabling coalesced memory accesses and efficient SIMT execution. To preserve global navigability under arbitrary filters, we design a hybrid graph topology that combines dense intra-bucket local edges with sparse inter-bucket remote edges. We further develop an append-only update pipeline that supports efficient batched insertions and parallel graph maintenance on GPUs. Extensive experiments on large-scale datasets show that GRAB-ANNS achieves up to 240.1 times higher query throughput and 12.6 times faster index construction than state-of-the-art CPU-based systems, and up to 10 times higher throughput compared to optimized GPU-native reimplementations, while maintaining high recall.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRAB-ANNS，一种面向GPU原生的图索引，用于动态混合搜索（结合向量相似性和结构化谓词过滤）。核心创新包括：基于桶的内存布局将范围谓词转换为高效桶选择；混合图拓扑平衡局部连通性和全局导航性；append-only更新管道支持GPU并行维护。在大规模数据集上的实验表明，该系统在查询吞吐量和索引构建速度上分别最高提升240.1倍和12.6倍，显著优于现有CPU和GPU方案。
AI.motivation: 现有predicate-aware ANN索引在CPU上受限于有限的内存带宽和并行度；将CPU中心的混合搜索算法直接移植到GPU会因不规则内存访问、分支分歧和过度CPU-GPU同步导致严重性能下降。
AI.method: 1) 提出基于桶的内存布局，将范围谓词转换为轻量级桶选择，实现合并内存访问和高效SIMT执行；2) 设计混合图拓扑，结合桶内密集局部边和桶间稀疏远程边以保持全局可导航性；3) 开发append-only更新管道，支持GPU上的高效批量插入和并行图维护。
AI.result: 相比最先进的CPU系统，查询吞吐量提升240.1倍，索引构建速度提升12.6倍；相比优化的GPU原生重实现，吞吐量提升10倍，同时保持高召回率。
AI.conclusion: GRAB-ANNS在GPU上实现了显著的性能提升（最高240.1倍查询吞吐量提升，12.6倍索引构建加速），同时在过滤条件下保持高召回率，证明了从硬件角度重新设计混合索引架构的有效性。

title: Clinical Note Bloat Reduction for Efficient LLM Use
summary: Health systems are rapidly deploying large language models (LLMs) that use clinical notes for clinical decision support applications. However, modern documentation practices rely heavily on templates, copy--paste shortcuts, and auto-populated fields, producing extensive duplicated text (``note bloat'') that dilutes clinically meaningful signal and substantially increases the computational cost of LLM use. We introduce TRACE, a scalable preprocessing pipeline that removes note bloat by leveraging EHR attribution metadata to identify templated and copied content and applying frequency-based deduplication when metadata are unavailable. We evaluated TRACE across four real--world clinical cohorts spanning liver transplantation, obstetrics, and inpatient care (5.3 million notes) using blinded physician review and downstream modeling tasks. TRACE removed 47.3% of chart text while preserving performance for information extraction and clinical outcome prediction. At a large academic medical center, this reduction corresponds to an estimated $9.5 million annual decrease in LLM inference costs assuming one query per encounter. These findings show how underutilized EHR metadata can enable more scalable and cost-efficient deployment of LLM-based clinical systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRACE系统，通过EHR元数据识别并移除临床笔记中的模板和复制内容，解决"笔记膨胀"问题。系统在530万份笔记的四个临床队列中验证，可压缩47.3%文本同时保持性能，并在大规模部署中每年节省约950万美元LLM推理成本。
AI.motivation: 现代临床文档实践大量依赖模板、复制粘贴和自动填充字段，导致"笔记膨胀"，稀释临床有意义信号，并大幅增加LLM使用的计算成本。
AI.method: 提出TRACE预处理管道，利用EHR归属元数据识别模板化和复制内容；在元数据不可用时采用基于频率的去重方法。评估方法包括：盲法医师审查和下游建模任务，涵盖四个真实临床队列（肝移植、产科、住院护理，530万份笔记）。
AI.result: TRACE移除47.3%的图表文本，同时保留信息提取和临床结果预测的性能。在大型学术医疗中心，假设每次就诊一次查询，该减少对应于估计每年950万美元的LLM推理成本降低。
AI.conclusion: TRACE通过利用EHR归属元数据识别模板和复制内容，在无元数据时采用基于频率的去重方法，实现了47.3%的文本压缩，同时保持信息提取和临床预测性能。该技术在大规模学术医疗中心的应用中，预计每年可节省约950万美元的LLM推理成本，证明了未充分利用的EHR元数据能够实现更可扩展且更具成本效益的LLM临床系统部署。

title: MARA: A Multimodal Adaptive Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Document Question Answering
summary: Retrieval-based multimodal document QA aims to identify and integrate relevant information from visually rich documents with complex multimodal structures. While retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has shown strong performance in text-based QA, its extensions to multimodal documents remain underexplored and face significant limitations. Specifically, current approaches rely on query-agnostic document representations that overlook salient content and use static top-k evidence selection, which fails to adapt to the uncertain distribution of relevant information. To address these limitations, we propose the Multimodal Adaptive Retrieval-Augmented (MARA) framework, which introduces query-adaptive mechanisms to both retrieval and generation. MARA consists of two components: a Query-Aligned Region Encoder that builds multi-level document representations and reweights them based on query relevance to improve retrieval precision; and a Self-Reflective Evidence Controller that monitors evidence sufficiency during generation and adaptively incorporates content from lower-ranked sources using a sliding-window strategy. Experiments on six multimodal QA benchmarks demonstrate that MARA consistently improves retrieval relevance and answer quality over existing SOTA method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MARA框架，通过查询自适应机制解决多模态文档问答中检索和生成的关键问题，在六个基准数据集上验证了性能提升。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成(RAG)在文本问答中表现良好，但其向多模态文档的扩展仍探索不足。现有问题包括：(1)使用查询无关的文档表示，忽略显著内容；(2)采用静态top-k证据选择，无法适应相关信息的动态分布。
AI.method: MARA框架包含两个核心组件：(1)查询对齐区域编码器(Query-Aligned Region Encoder)：构建多层级文档表示，基于查询相关性重新加权，提升检索精度；(2)自我反思证据控制器(Self-Reflective Evidence Controller)：在生成过程中监控证据充分性，使用滑动窗口策略自适应纳入低排名来源的内容。
AI.result: 在六个多模态QA基准数据集上的实验表明，MARA在检索相关性和答案质量上均优于现有最优方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入查询自适应机制，MARA有效解决了多模态文档检索和生成中的核心问题，实现了检索精度和生成质量的协同提升。

title: A Discordance-Aware Multimodal Framework with Multi-Agent Clinical Reasoning
summary: Knee osteoarthritis frequently exhibits discordance between structural damage observed in imaging and patient-reported symptoms such as pain. This mismatch complicates clinical interpretation and patient stratification and remains insufficiently modeled in existing decision support systems. We propose a discordance aware multimodal framework that combines machine learning prediction models with a tool grounded multi agent reasoning system. Using baseline data from the FNIH Osteoarthritis Biomarkers Consortium, we trained multimodal models to predict two progression tasks, joint space loss only progression versus non progression, and pain only progression versus non progression. The predictive system integrates three modality specific experts: a CatBoost tabular model using demographic, radiographic, MRI-derived scalar, and biomarker features; MRI image embeddings extracted using a ResNet18 backbone; and Xray embeddings derived from the same architecture. Expert predictions are fused using a stacking ensemble. Residual based models estimate expected pain from structural features, enabling the computation of a pain structure discordance score between observed and expected symptoms. A multi-agent reasoning layer interprets these signals to assign clinically interpretable OA phenotypes and generate phenotype specific management recommendations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个不协调感知的多模态框架，用于膝骨关节炎的预测和管理。该框架结合机器学习预测模型与多智能体推理系统，使用FNIH骨关节炎生物标志物联盟的基线数据，训练模型预测两个进展任务（关节间隙丢失进展和疼痛进展）。框架整合了三个模态特异性专家模型（CatBoost表格模型、MRI图像嵌入、X射线嵌入），通过堆叠集成融合预测结果，并利用残差模型估计结构特征对应的预期疼痛水平，从而计算疼痛-结构不协调分数。多智能体推理层可解读这些信号，分配临床可解释的OA表型并生成表型特异性的管理建议。
AI.motivation: Knee osteoarthritis frequently shows discordance between structural damage observed in imaging and patient-reported symptoms such as pain. This mismatch complicates clinical interpretation and patient stratification. Existing decision support systems inadequately model this discordance, highlighting the need for a framework that can simultaneously capture structural and symptomatic aspects of OA progression.
AI.method: The study used baseline data from the FNIH Osteoarthritis Biomarkers Consortium to train multimodal prediction models. Three modality-specific experts were integrated: (1) a CatBoost tabular model using demographic, radiographic, MRI-derived scalar, and biomarker features; (2) MRI image embeddings extracted using ResNet18 backbone; (3) X-ray embeddings from the same architecture. Expert predictions were fused using a stacking ensemble. Residual-based models were developed to estimate expected pain from structural features, enabling computation of a pain-structure discordance score between observed and expected symptoms.
AI.result: The proposed framework successfully integrates three modality-specific experts (tabular, MRI, and X-ray) through a stacking ensemble. The residual-based models enable estimation of expected pain levels from structural features, allowing computation of a pain-structure discordance score. The multi-agent reasoning layer assigns clinically interpretable OA phenotypes and generates phenotype-specific management recommendations.
AI.conclusion: The framework successfully addresses the clinically important challenge of imaging-symptom discordance in knee OA. The residual-based discordance scoring enables identification of patients whose pain levels deviate from what structural features would predict, while the multi-agent reasoning layer provides interpretable phenotype assignments and actionable management recommendations. This approach may improve patient stratification for clinical trials and treatment decisions.

title: Rethinking Artifact Evaluation for Software Engineering in the Age of Generative AI
comment: To appear in 2026 IEEE/ACM 48th International Conference on Software Engineering: Future of Software Engineering (ICSE-FoSE), April 12-18, 2026, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
summary: Peer review in software engineering research operates under tight time constraints, while generative AI has substantially reduced the human effort required to produce polished research narratives. Reviewer attention is often spent on aspects of submissions such as writing quality or literature positioning that have become relatively less effort-intensive to address, rather than on evaluating the scientific substance of a paper. At the same time, assessing whether methods are implemented correctly, analyses are sound, and claims are supported by evidence remains effort-intensive and dependent on human expertise. In software engineering research, this substance is frequently embodied in artifacts, including code, data, evidence and analysis samples, and experimental infrastructure. In this position paper, we argue that artifact evaluation should be treated as a first-class component of peer review. We frame peer review as an attention allocation problem, examine how generative AI weakens narrative quality as a signal of rigor, and argue that artifact evaluation should play a more prominent role in peer review decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文，探讨软件工程研究同行评审中的注意力分配问题。随着生成式AI降低了研究叙事的撰写成本，审稿人容易将注意力集中在写作质量或文献定位等表面要素上，而科学实质内容（方法正确性、分析严谨性、证据充分性）的评估仍需大量人力。作者主张将工件评估（artifact evaluation）提升为同行评审的核心组成部分，使其在评审决策中发挥更重要作用。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI显著降低了高质量研究叙事的产出难度，导致审稿人将有限注意力消耗在写作质量、文献定位等表面要素上，而真正体现科学严谨性的方法实现、实验基础设施、代码与数据等工件反而缺乏系统性评估。软件工程研究中，科学实质内容常以工件形式体现，但现有评审机制未能有效评估这些工件的质量与可复现性。
AI.method: 作者将同行评审问题框架化为注意力分配问题，分析生成式AI如何削弱叙事质量作为严谨性信号的有效性，考察软件工程领域工件评估的现状与挑战。
AI.result: 论文核心立场：工件评估应被视为同行评审的第一类组件，在评审决策中发挥更重要作用。
AI.conclusion: 在生成式AI时代，同行评审面临注意力错配危机。将工件评估提升为核心评审要素，是恢复科学严谨性信号、应对AI驱动叙事泛滥的关键路径。

title: CFMS: Towards Explainable and Fine-Grained Chinese Multimodal Sarcasm Detection Benchmark
summary: Multimodal sarcasm detection has recently garnered significant attention. However, existing benchmarks suffer from coarse-grained annotations and limited cultural coverage, which hinder research into fine-grained semantic understanding. To address this, we construct CFMS, the first fine-grained multimodal sarcasm dataset tailored for Chinese social media. It comprises 2,796 high-quality image-text pairs and provides a triple-level annotation framework: sarcasm identification, target recognition, and explanation generation. We find that the fine-grained explanation annotations effectively guide AI in generating images with explicit sarcastic intent. Furthermore, we curate a high-consistency parallel Chinese-English metaphor subset (200 entries each), revealing significant limitations of current models in metaphoric reasoning. To overcome the constraints of traditional retrieval methods, we propose a Reinforcement Learning-augmented In-Context Learning strategy (PGDS) to dynamically optimize exemplar selection. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CFMS provides a solid foundation for building reliable multimodal sarcasm understanding systems, and the PGDS method significantly outperforms existing baselines on key tasks. Our data and code are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CFMS-E8F9.

AI.tldr: 本文针对现有细粒度多模态讽刺数据集的缺陷，构建了首个面向中文社交媒体的CFMS数据集（2,796条图像-文本对，三级标注框架），并提出PGDS强化学习策略优化示例选择。实验表明该数据集和 方法能显著提升多模态讽刺理解能力，同时揭示了当前模型在跨语言隐喻推理方面的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态讽刺检测基准数据集存在标注粒度粗、文化覆盖有限的问题，阻碍了细粒度语义理解研究。
AI.method: 构建CFMS细粒度多模态讽刺数据集（2,796条图像-文本对），提供三级标注框架（讽刺识别、目标识别、解释生成）；提出RL增强的上下文学习策略PGDS，动态优化示例选择；构建高一致性中英隐喻子集（各200条）。
AI.result: 细粒度解释标注能有效指导AI生成具有明确讽刺意图的图像；当前模型在隐喻推理方面存在显著局限；PGDS方法显著优于现有基线。
AI.conclusion: CFMS数据集为可靠的多模态讽刺理解系统提供了坚实基础；PGDS方法在关键任务上显著优于现有基线；数据代码已开源。

title: Heterogeneous Self-Play for Realistic Highway Traffic Simulation
summary: Realistic highway simulation is critical for scalable safety evaluation of autonomous vehicles, particularly for interactions that are too rare to study from logged data alone. Yet highway traffic generation remains challenging because it requires broad coverage across speeds and maneuvers, controllable generation of rare safety-critical scenarios, and behavioral credibility in multi-agent interactions. We present PHASE, Policy for Heterogeneous Agent Self-play on Expressway, a context-aware self-play framework that addresses these three requirements through explicit per-agent conditioning for controllability, synthetic scenario generation for broad highway coverage, and closed-loop multi-agent training for realistic interaction dynamics. PHASE further supports different vehicle profiles, for example, passenger cars and articulated trailer trucks, within a single policy via vehicle-aware dynamics and context-conditioned actions, and stabilizes self-play with early termination of unrecoverable states, at-fault collision attribution, highway-aware reward shaping, coupled curricula, and robust policy optimization. Despite being trained only on synthetic data, PHASE transfers zero-shot to 512 unseen high-interaction real scenarios in exiD, achieving a 96.3% success rate and reducing ADE/FDE from 6.57/12.07 m to 2.44/5.25 m relative to a prior self-play baseline. In a learned trajectory embedding space, it also improves behavioral realism over IDM, reducing Frechet trajectory distance by 13.1% and energy distance by 20.2%. These results show that synthetic self-play can provide a scalable route to controllable and realistic highway scenario generation without direct imitation of expert logs.

AI.tldr: PHASE是一个用于高速公路的上下文感知自博弈框架，通过显式条件化、合成场景生成和闭环多智能体训练，实现可控且逼真的公路场景生成。该方法仅用合成数据训练即可零样本迁移到真实场景，显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 公路交通生成面临三大挑战：1)需要广泛的速度和机动覆盖范围；2)需要可控地生成罕见安全关键场景；3)多智能体交互中需要行为可信度。现有方法难以同时满足这些要求。
AI.method: 通过显式按智能体条件化实现可控生成、合成场景生成实现广泛覆盖、闭环多智能体训练实现逼真交互动力学；支持不同车型（乘用车和铰接卡车）；采用不可恢复状态早终止、过责碰撞归因、公路感知奖励塑形、耦合课程和鲁棒策略优化来稳定自博弈训练。
AI.result: 在exiD的512个未见高交互真实场景中实现零样本迁移，成功率达96.3%，ADE/FDE从6.57/12.07m降至2.44/5.25m；相比IDM，Frechet轨迹距离降低13.1%，能量距离降低20.2%。
AI.conclusion: PHASE实现了零样本迁移到真实场景，在512个未见过的交互密集场景中达到96.3%成功率，ADE/FDE从6.57/12.07m降至2.44/5.25m，相比IDM使FTD降低13.1%、能量距离降低20.2%，证明合成自博弈可为公路场景生成提供可扩展且可控的解决方案。

title: From Swap Axioms to Weighted Geometric Means: A Characterization of AMMs
summary:
Many automated market makers can be understood through the geometry of their trading orbits, the sets of states reachable from one another through swaps. In prominent designs, this geometry is captured by a simple closed-form invariant such as the constant product $xy$ in Uniswap or a weighted geometric mean $x^w y^{1-w}$ in Balancer.
  This paper explains why these forms arise by deriving them from three basic assumptions: validity invariance (swaps preserve the validity of states), Pareto efficiency (no state on an orbit weakly dominates another), and unit invariance (changing measurement units does not change the mechanism). Together, these force every trading orbit of a two-asset AMM to be a level set of a weighted geometric mean $x^w y^{1-w}$. Applied pairwise, the axioms extend the classification to $n$-asset pools: orbits are level sets of $\prod_i x_i^{w_i}$ with positive weights $w_i$ summing to $1$. Imposing token-relabeling symmetry then pins down the weights, recovering the constant-product form $xy$ in the two-asset case and $\prod_i x_i$ in general.
  The main text provides an intuitive proof sketch and discusses fees and liquidity operations. Complete proofs and a machine-checked Lean 4 formalization accompany the paper.

AI.tldr: 本文从三个基本公理（有效性不变性、Pareto效率、单位不变性）出发，推导出两资产AMM的交易轨道必为加权几何平均 x^w y^(1-w) 的水平集，进而扩展到n资产情况为 ∏_i x_i^(w_i)，施加代币重标记对称性后得到常数乘积形式 xy（或一般情况下的 ∏_i x_i）。
AI.motivation: 理解为什么主流AMM设计（如Uniswap的常数乘积xy=k，Balancer的加权几何平均 x^w y^(1-w)）具有特定的数学形式，即从基本原理出发解释这些AMM设计为何如此。
AI.method: 从三个基本假设出发进行推导：(1) 有效性不变性（交换保持状态有效性）；(2) Pareto效率（轨道上无状态弱支配另一状态）；(3) 单位不变性（改变计量单位不改变机制）。通过成对应用这些公理将分类扩展到n资产池。
AI.result: 三个公理共同迫使两资产AMM的每个交易轨道成为加权几何平均 x^w y^(1-w) 的水平集。推广到n资产池，轨道是 ∏_i x_i^(w_i) 的水平集（权重 w_i 为正且和为1）。施加代币重标记对称性后，权重被唯一确定，恢复两资产的常数乘积形式 xy 和一般情况的 ∏_i x_i。
AI.conclusion: 主文提供直观的证明草图并讨论费用和流动性操作。完整证明及机器验证的Lean 4形式化伴随论文附上。

title: FliX: Flipped-Indexing for Scalable GPU Queries and Updates
summary:
GPU-based concurrent data structures (CDSs) achieve high throughput for read-only queries, but efficient support for dynamic updates on fully GPU-resident data remains challenging. Ordered CDSs (e.g., B-trees and LSM-trees) maintain an index layer that directs operations to a data layer (buckets or leaves), while hash tables avoid the cost of maintaining order but do not support range or successor queries. On GPUs, maintaining and traversing an index layer under frequent updates introduces contention and warp divergence.
  To tackle these problems, we flip the indexing paradigm on its head with FliX, a comparison-based, flipped indexing strategy for dynamic, fully GPU-resident CDSs. Traditional GPU CDSs typically take a batch of operations and assign each operation to a GPU thread or warp. FliX, however, assigns compute (e.g., a warp) to each bucket in the data layer, and each bucket then locates operations it is responsible for in the batch. FliX can replace many index layer traversals with a single binary search on the batch, reducing redundant work and warp divergence. Further, FliX simplifies updates as no index layer must be maintained.
  In our experiments, FliX achieves 6.5x reduced query latency compared to a leading GPU B-tree and 1.5x compared to a leading GPU LSM-tree, while delivering 4x higher throughput per memory footprint than ordered competitors. Despite maintaining order, FliX also surpasses state-of-the-art unordered GPU hash tables in query and deletion performance, and is highly competitive in insertion performance. In update-heavy workloads, it outperforms the closest fully dynamic ordered baseline by over 8x in insertion throughput while supporting dynamic memory reclamation. These results suggest that eliminating the index layer and adopting a compute-to-bucket mapping can enable practical, fully dynamic GPU indexing without sacrificing query performance.

AI.tldr: FliX 是一种面向全 GPU 常驻数据的“翻转索引”(flipped indexing) 并发数据结构：它放弃传统“索引层+数据层”两层结构，改为把计算单元(线程/tile)分配给数据层的每个 bucket，由 bucket 主动在已排序的批量操作列表上做一次二分查找来“拉取”属于自己的操作，从而省去所有索引层遍历与维护。实验表明其点查询延迟比主流 GPU B-tree 低 6.5 倍、比 GPU LSM-tree 低 1.5 倍，单位内存吞吐比有序基线高 4 倍；插入吞吐比 B-tree 高 8 倍以上、删除性能优于两款哈希表，并支持动态内存回收与 GPU 内重构。
AI.motivation: GPU 并发数据结构(CDS)在只读查询上吞吐极高，但对全 GPU 常驻数据的动态插入/删除支持仍然困难。现有结构普遍是两层设计：数据层(桶/叶节点)存放数据，索引层(B-tree 树、LSM 的多层、哈希桶链)把键路由到数据层。在 GPU 上频繁更新时，索引层的维护与遍历会带来争用、warp divergence(线程分支发散)、非合并的散乱内存写以及显著内存开销；哈希表虽免去维护顺序的代价，却无法支持范围查询与 successor(后继)查询。此外，GPU 内存访问延迟高、主机与设备间带宽极昂贵，索引必须依赖批处理来摊薄拷贝开销，这使得“把计算映射到操作”的传统 GPU 执行模型与高效的桶内协同执行难以兼容。作者的核心提问是：与其让查询键去“找”它该落入哪个桶，不如从桶出发去问“哪些键属于我”。
AI.method: 1) 范式翻转：FliX 采用 compute-to-bucket 映射，每个 bucket 分配一个计算单元(ST 内核为单线程，TL 内核为一个 tile/协作组)。批量操作先在 GPU 上排序，随后每个 bucket 以自身的 maxBucket(桶内允许的最大键)对有序操作列表做一次二分搜索定位其子列表，就地顺序执行，从而用一次 O(log batch) 的二分查找替代可能多次 O(log index) 的索引层遍历。2) 数据结构：构建时将排序后的键按大小 p = nodesize/2 分组形成桶，节点(node)保存 maxKey 与 size，节点以 node-link 指针串联成桶链；每桶最大键存入 MKBA(max key per bucket array)数组用于划分桶间键区间。3) 查询：每个桶一次二分搜索得到起始位置后顺序处理直至键超过 maxBucket；未命中返回 not found 标记；命中则将 rowID 写入结果缓冲返回主机；查询采用 TL-Bulk 方式(ST 版因查询数远多于桶数而更慢)。4) 更新内核：对插入实现 ST-Shift-Right(右移插入+节点分裂)、ST-Bulk(线程局部拷贝空间整体归并)、TL-Shift-Right、TL-Bulk(把原节点键“抬升”进寄存器，按 successor boundary(test-key)分区间原地归并，无拷贝空间)，以及 ST-Hybrid/TL-Hybrid 与 ST-TL-Mixed 混合策略；删除采用 ST-Shift-Left、TL-Shift-Left、TL-Bulk(掩码标记+按前序删除计数左移压实)，删除为物理删除、不使用 tombstone。5) 重构(restructuring)：全 GPU 上把长节点链的桶扁平化为单节点桶以对齐当前分布并消除长链遍历，同时合并 underfull 节点回收内存。6) 方法论：先做形成性(formative)合成实验扫描节点大小、TPB 分配、键分布、批量大小与内核变体，再做总结性(summative)大规模对比；基线为 GPU B-tree、HT-Slab、HT-Warpcore 以及作者扩展的 LSMu(LSM-tree 的原位 tombstone 变体，支持 successor)，环境为 NVIDIA A6000 + Xeon Gold 5220。
AI.result: (1) 查询：点查询延迟比 B-tree 低 6.5 倍、比 LSMu 低 1.5 倍；计入排序成本后，在 2^25 构建/2^26 查询规模下仍比 B-tree 快 5 倍、比 LSMu 快 14 倍，并超过两个哈希表；第 8 轮时未命中查询比哈希表快 2–2.6 倍(哈希表因 tombstone 累积而退化)。(2) 内存效率：查询吞吐/内存占用(QTMF)比有序基线高 4 倍以上，为所有基线中最佳；内存消耗比 LSMu 低 2.8 倍，低于 B-tree。(3) 插入：TL-Bulk 比 B-tree 快 8.2 倍、比 HT-Slab 快 1.6 倍，与 HT-Warpcore 相当；LSMu 插入最快但内存开销大。(4) 删除：TL-Bulk 优于除 LSMu 外的所有基线，平均比 B-tree 快 4.4 倍、比 HT-Slab 快 2.2 倍、比 HT-Warpcore 快 1.8 倍。(5) successor 查询：LSMu 因 tombstone 遍历退化，第 8 轮 FliX 响应时间约为其 1/69000。(6) 分布偏移：即使插入集中在 2% 键区间，查询性能退化小于 0.5 ms，compute-to-bucket 映射对偏斜非常鲁棒。(7) 重构：可回收最多 46% 的节点空间(通过合并 underfull 节点)，单次重构耗时约 200–800 ms。(8) 最佳配置经验：TL-Bulk 插入/删除配合 NS=2^5、TPB=128 在绝大多数工作负载最优；轻插入压力与较小增长(≤100%)时 ST-Shift-Right 仍有竞争力，混合内核整体不如单一策略。排序开销很低(2^26 约 6.5 ms，2^28 约 26 ms)。范围查询未纳入评测(基线支持有限)。
AI.conclusion: 消除索引层、改用“计算映射到桶”的翻转索引，可在不牺牲查询性能的前提下实现实用的高效全动态 GPU 索引。FliX 在有序基线中取得最佳综合性能(QTMF、查询与删除)，同时在查询与插入上意外地可与最先进的无序 GPU 哈希表竞争甚至超越；通过 GPU 内重构与 underfull 节点合并实现持续增长下的内存回收，并具备对显著分布偏移的鲁棒性。作者认为翻转索引可为动态 GPU 数据库索引提供可行、高效、可扩展的未来方向；后续工作可考虑方向包括让删除也合并 underfull 节点、在不同轮次间按负载选择内核、以及评估范围查询性能。

title: Dynamics of Cognitive Heterogeneity: Investigating Behavioral Biases in Multi-Stage Supply Chains with LLM-Based Simulation
comment: Accepted to the Main Conference of ACL 2026. 18 pages, 8 figures in total (9 pages, 7 figures for the main text)
summary: Modeling coordination among generative agents in complex multi-round decision-making presents a core challenge for AI and operations management. Although behavioral experiments have revealed cognitive biases behind supply chain inefficiencies, traditional methods face scalability and control limitations. We introduce a scalable experimental paradigm using Large Language Models (LLMs) to simulate multi-stage supply chain dynamics. Grounded in a Hierarchical Reasoning Framework, this study specifically analyzes the impact of cognitive heterogeneity on agent interactions. Unlike prior homogeneous settings, we employ DeepSeek and GPT agents to systematically vary reasoning sophistication across supply chain tiers. Through rigorously replicated and statistically validated simulations, we investigate how this cognitive diversity influences collective outcomes. Results indicate that agents exhibit myopic and self-interested behaviors that exacerbate systemic inefficiencies. However, we demonstrate that information sharing effectively mitigates these adverse effects. Our findings extend traditional behavioral methods and offer new insights into the dynamics of AI-enabled organizations. This work underscores both the potential and limitations of LLM-based agents as proxies for human decision-making in complex operational environments.

AI.tldr: 本文用大语言模型（DeepSeek-V3/R1、GPT-4.1/GPT-5）作为"可控战略行为者"，在经典啤酒分销游戏（Beer Distribution Game）四阶段供应链中做多轮重复仿真，系统检验认知异质性（Hierarchical Reasoning Framework）如何影响牛鞭效应、信息共享的作用，以及代理者是否复现人类的行为偏差。结论是：LLM 代理稳定复现牛鞭效应并表现出近视（低估在途供应，a_N>a_I）与自利偏差；信息共享是有效解药；但在信息隔离下，仅仅提升单个上游代理的认知能力反而会恶化系统整体绩效（"更聪明反而更糟"的悖论）。
AI.motivation: 传统行为运营研究（如 Sterman 1989 的牛鞭效应、Croson & Donohue 2006 的库存/缺货成本实验）长期依赖人类被试实验，存在三类瓶颈：(1) 可扩展性差、成本高；(2) 无法对被试的"认知深度/战略理性层级"进行精确测量与操控，导致异质性策略只能观察不能因果识别；(3) 样本量小、多缺乏重复与统计验证，结论稳健性有限。而 LLM 作为可编程、可复现、可精确设定个体特征的"生成式代理"，具备规模化和实验可控性优势，但既有 LLM 多智能体研究多集中于横向社交互动、静态博弈或同质代理，缺少制度化（垂直结构、多期、信息不对称）的多阶段供应链情境，认知异质性的作用几乎未被研究。此外，启发式基线（需求跟踪策略）与强化学习基线（IPPO/MAPPO）需严格定义状态空间与大量环境特异训练，无法刻画有认知弹性的人类决策。因此本文试图构建"LLM 代理 + 规则式架构"的虚拟实验室，既复现经典行为规律，又因果识别认知构成对集体绩效的影响。
AI.method:
环境：严格按运营管理文献规范实现四阶段啤酒分销游戏（零售商 S1、批发商 S2、分销商 S3、制造商 S4），T=20 期，需求 D_t ~ U[0,8]（仅零售商可见），前置期 2 期（制造商 3 期生产延迟），初始库存 12 单位，单位持有成本 0.5、单位缺货成本 1.0；各代理以最小化自身持有+缺货总成本为激励。
认知层级操作化（Hierarchical Reasoning Framework）：采用"casting 而非 coaching"原则，不通过提示词教模型"更聪明"，而是直接指定不同模型——认知浅层 = DeepSeek-V3 / GPT-4.1，认知深层 = DeepSeek-R1 / GPT-5；依据二者在 AIME、GPQA、MMLU、SWE-bench 等推理密集型基准上的稳定优势，以及模拟内更低的总成本与订单方差（附录 C、表 4）双重验证该分类。
实验条件：同质条件 Original（四个浅层）与 R-Overall（四个深层）；异质条件 R-S1~R-S4（仅一个深层代理置于某层级，其余为浅层），共 6 种配置 × 2 模型族；每配置独立重复 32 次；温度固定为 1（结果对温度稳健）；全部代理使用 CoT 提示。
信息结构操纵：IS 关闭（系统提示明确"对其他层级库存/缺货零可见"）vs. IS 开启（提供四个阶段全量库存与缺货的实时数据）。提示词"科学极简主义"，不含人格化/方法演技类提示。
对照基线：需求跟踪启发式策略、IPPO（共享参数独立训练）、MAPPO（集中式价值函数），奖励为阶段化利润。
统计方法：符号检验（订单放大）、t 检验与 Mann–Whitney U 检验（IS 前后方差比较）、Sterman 经典回归 O_t = a0 + a_I·I_{t-1} + a_R·R_t + a_S·S_t + a_N·N_t + a_t·t + ε，通过 a_N 与 a_I 的比较识别供应链线低权重（近视），再以成本结构刻画自利行为；DeepSeek vs GPT 的"人格"差异用单尾 MWU 检验。
AI.result:
1) 复现有效性：与预期相反，H1 被推翻——即使需求分布已知且平稳，LLM 代理仍出现显著牛鞭效应（符号检验 N=96，p<0.001），DeepSeek Original/R-Overall 订单方差分别放大 82.3%/79.8%，GPT 74.2%/74.3%；代理的订单方差与标准差远低于人类基准（UTD、UW-Madison），决策更稳定。
2) 信息共享（H2 成立）：IS 在全部四种同质配置下显著降低订单方差（MWU：DS-Original p<0.001、DS-Overall p=0.042、GPT-Original p=0.044、GPT-Overall p=0.018），且在人类实验中仅部分显著（UTD p=0.221 vs UW p=0.048），显示 LLM 代理具备"处理效应敏感性优势"。
3) 异质性下牛鞭效应依然稳健（所有异质配置 N=96，p<0.001；IS 缓解效应在多数位置 p<0.05），说明系统性结构与信息不对称压倒个体认知能力。
4) 近视偏差（H3 被推翻）：所有配置下 a_N > a_I 恒成立（符号检验 N=128，p<0.001），稳定复现人类"低权重在途供应"模式；对照基线中需求跟踪策略不显著（p=0.99），IPPO（p<0.001）与 MAPPO（p=0.021）显著。
5) 自利行为：信息隔离下提升上游代理（S2/S3/S4）会降低其自身局部成本却抬高全链总成本，暴露个体激励与系统绩效的错位；IS 可基本消除该模式，最优总成本仅出现在"IS + R-Overall"。
6) 反直觉机制：在不透明环境下，单个上游代理的认知增强反而使订单方差高于同质基线——"更聪明"放大了对局部噪声的近视性过度反应；R-Overall（全深层）与 R-S1 例外。
7) 模型族"人格"：12 个条件中 9 个显示 DeepSeek 显著低于 GPT 的方差（p<0.001~0.018），DeepSeek 偏稳定保守、GPT 偏波动；但在 R-Overall 下两者差异不显著（p=0.247/0.372），即最高认知层级上风格差异消解，二者独立收敛到近最优策略。
AI.conclusion:
本文的主要贡献是确立了一条可扩展、可控、可复制的"LLM 作为可控战略行为者"的行为运营研究范式：以多期、多轮、32 次重复的严格统计验证支撑，LLM 代理在决策稳定性与统计清晰度上优于人类基准，可作为人类决策的补充性/补充性验证代理，尤其在人类数据结论不明确时展现敏感性优势。理论上，本文确立"认知异质性不足以修正系统性偏差"这一结论：结构性信息不对称与信息共享的作用远大于个体智力提升；近视与自利两类人类式偏差是驱动牛鞭效应的微观机制，而透明的信息共享同时纠正二者，是唯一可靠的对冲手段。在方法论上，模型族差异（DeepSeek 稳定 vs GPT 波动）会污染"认知层级"这一自变量的解释力——这是该范式最关键的混淆风险与后续研究必须处理的问题。

局限与展望：一是把商业模型的"深度推理"作为认知深度的代理，无法排除训练数据与 RL 目标带来的混淆，跨模型族的细微差异难以解耦；二是框架将深层代理嵌入浅层团队，未建模对交互方有限理性的自适应识别；三是仅依赖经典啤酒分销游戏这一确定性环境，忽略随机扰动与复杂网络拓扑。后续方向包括：扩展至其他行为运营域（密封报价拍卖中的基于遗憾的策略适应、排队系统中可见负载下的绩效差异、报童模型中的利润边际偏差），并改进对"认知深度"的可控操作化与对模型族人格差异的控制。

title: Method for Aggregating Unstructured Data Using Large Language Models
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures. Preprint. Accepted for ICMLC 2026
summary: This paper presents a method for the automated collection and aggregation of unstructured data from diverse web sources, utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs). The primary challenge with existing techniques is their instability when the structure of webpages changes, their limited support for dynamically loaded content during information collection, and the requirement for labor-intensive manual design of data pre-processing processes. The proposed algorithm integrates hybrid web scraping (Goose3 for static pages and Selenium+WebDriver for dynamic ones), data storage in a non-relational MongoDB database management system (DBMS), and intelligent extraction and normalization of information using LLMs into a predetermined JSON schema. A key scientific contribution of this study is a two-stage verification process for the generated data, designed to eliminate potential hallucinations byy comparing the embeddings of multiple LLM outputs obtained with different temperature parameter values, combined with formalized rules for monitoring data consistency and integrity. The experimental findings indicate a high level of accuracy in the completion of key fields, as well as the robustness of the proposed methodology to changes in web page structures. This makes it suitable for use in tasks such as news content aggregation, monitoring, and log analysis in near real-time mode, with the capacity to scale rapidly in terms of the number of sources.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套基于大语言模型（LLM）的非结构化网络数据自动采集与聚合方法：由 BeautifulSoup/Goose3 与 Selenium+WebDriver 组成混合爬虫负责静态与动态页面抓取，数据以 MongoDB 非关系库存储，经语义嵌入去重后交由 LLM 按预设 JSON Schema 抽取并归一化，最后通过“两阶段验证”（多温度多次生成+嵌入相似度对比，以及格式/必填字段/类型的规则校验）抑制幻觉。实验表明：新闻摘要与原文的 BERT 语义相似度平均 87%；在 1200 条日志上幻觉率由 18.2% 降至 N=3 时 3.8%、N=5 时 1.5%，代价与延迟呈次线性增长（y=2√x）；在 45 份金融文档上相较基线 LLM-TKIE，字段级 F-score 由 86.1% 提升至 98.7%，关键错误率由 12.4% 降至 2.5%，幻觉率由 28.7% 降至 3.5%。方法具备实时性、结构鲁棒性与可扩展性，但存在计算成本/延迟上升、依赖提示工程与外部嵌入模型等局限。
AI.motivation: 针对新闻门户、在线商城、日志等结构不稳定、含动态加载内容的非结构化数据源，传统基于 XPath/CSS 选择器、正则或模板的抓取与信息抽取方法存在三类核心痛点：（1）对网页结构变化极度脆弱，一旦布局调整即需人工重新配置解析器，长期监测成本高；（2）难以支持 SPA、无限滚动等动态渲染内容；（3）信息抽取需依赖针对每类实体标注语料的模型（BiLSTM-CRF、finetuned transformer），迁移到新数据类别时精度下降且维护繁重。纯 LLM 直接逐页处理虽通用、具备零/少样本能力，但带来高成本与高延迟，且输出具有随机性（幻觉），并缺乏内建的去重与形式化校验机制。因此需要一种结合传统抓取效率、IE 模型结构化能力与 LLM 灵活性的混合方案，并在流程内嵌自动质量保证机制，从而免去逐条人工校验。
AI.method: 提出四级串联的可扩展流水线（并用 IDEF0/IDEF1/DFD 建模描述）。步骤1 混合采集与初始存储：BeautifulSoup+Goose3 快速解析静态页并自动选择 CSS 选择器、沿关联链接抽取正文，Selenium+WebDriver 处理动态内容；原始数据持久化至 MongoDB 非关系库。步骤2 语义去重：用 Sentence-BERT / all-MiniLM-L6-v2 生成嵌入，与既有文档计算余弦相似度，超阈值即判定重复并丢弃，节省算力。步骤3 LLM 抽取与归一化：将对象文本与包含指令、目标 JSON Schema、示例及处理规则的提示词一并提交 LLM API，抽取关键实体、聚合并归一化写入指定 JSON 字段，结果存入“normalized storage”独立集合。步骤4 多级验证与质量保证：第一阶段做幻觉检测——以温度 0.3–0.7 生成基线响应 N0，再以更低温度生成 N1、N2 等重复响应，在嵌入空间计算与 N0 的语义相似度并检查结构一致性，相似度低于阈值即标记为疑似幻觉，送入再处理或人工复核；第二阶段自动校验数据类型、必填字段与格式规范性，不合规文档退回重处理。架构支持任意阶段水平扩展，并可通过 API 输出 JSON 结构的聚合结果。实验指标包括 BERT Similarity（bert-base-multilingual-uncased，mean pooling 末层隐状态、余弦相似度）、加权 Field-level F-score、Critical Error Rate（关键字段至少一项错误的文档比例）、Hallucination Rate（凭空填写原文不存在字段的文档比例）、token 消耗与延迟。
AI.result: 实验1（新闻语料，1600 篇新闻及其摘要）：原文与生成摘要的平均 BERT 相似度为 87%，各类别阈值落在 85%–89%，说明聚合过程中语义内容基本无损。实验2（日志语料，1200 个日志文件，gpt-4o-mini，上下文 4000 tokens，基线温度 0.7、重复温度 0.1）：无校验时幻觉率 18.2%；N=2 降至 7.6%（1600 tokens/条、780 ms），N=3 降至 3.8%（3200 tokens、1320 ms），N=5 降至 1.5%（6400 tokens、2160 ms），token 与延迟随重复次数线性增长而质量提升次线性，经验关系为 y=2√x（x 为重复数，y 为相对基线的改进），据此推荐使用 2–3 个重复以在质量与成本间折中。实验3（45 份金融文档，与基线 LLM-TKIE 对比）：字段级加权 F-score 由 86.1% 提升至 98.7%，关键错误率由 12.4% 降至 2.5%，幻觉率由 28.7% 降至 3.5%。对比表显示，该方法在重复数据处理、相似新闻检测、自动化程度与从采集到摘要的全链路处理时间上均优于所列已有方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法把混合采集、非关系存储、LLM 结构化处理与两阶段验证整合为统一流水线，在结构易变的异构源上兼具实时性、鲁棒性与可扩展性，能够在无需人工逐条校验的情况下保证输出质量，语义保真度约 87%。相较基线方案显著降低幻觉与关键错误，同时保持高字段精度，可广泛用于新闻与价格实时聚合、监控、日志分析与错误修复建议生成等场景；随着未来 LLM 能力提升，算法还有望进一步增强数据聚合质量与信息准确性的验证能力。局限在于多温度多次调用使 token 消耗与延迟随 N 线性上升（质量提升却呈次线性），对提示工程与外部嵌入模型依赖较强，且多数验证依赖相似度阈值等经验设定。

title: "CS 1.5": An Experience Report on Integrating CS1 and Discrete Structures for the AI Era
summary: The rapid proliferation of generative AI has fundamentally altered the landscape of introductory computer science education. Traditional methods that prioritize syntax memorization and writing code from scratch are challenged by tools that can generate such code instantly. In response, we designed and implemented an experimental course integration at Northeastern University Vancouver, merging "Intensive Foundations of Computer Science" (CS1) and "Discrete Structures" into a single, cohesive studio experience. Dubbed "CS 1.5"--a playful nod to its position between CS1 and CS2--this course operates on two core principles: embracing AI as a collaborator rather than an adversary, and prioritizing deep theoretical foundations alongside practical implementation. This report details our pedagogical interventions, including the restructuring of the timetable to support a 4-hour studio format, the introduction of "sharing circles" to foster human connection, and the strategic shift to "code comprehension" over code generation. We discuss specific integrated projects--spanning set theory, recursion, and probability--that bridge the gap between mathematical proofs and software implementation. Finally, we reflect on the changing role of the instructor--from a repository of knowledge to a human mentor--and offer practical recommendations for scaling this high-touch, integrated model.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇教学经验报告：作者在东北大学温哥华校区把"CS1 入门编程"与"离散结构"两门课合并成一门实验性课程"CS 1.5"，通过 4 小时studio + 2 小时习题课的翻转课堂模式，以"拥抱 AI"和"基础优先"为两大原则，用大型代码库（2000–3000 行）驱动"代码理解"而非"代码生成"，以"分享圈"和"代码走查"（Code Walk）重塑评估与师生关系，并提出 5 个跨学科项目（集合论、递归与归纳、概率蒙特卡洛等）作为桥梁，同时坦诚小样本（n=11）、高投入与行政流程不足等局限。
AI.motivation: 生成式 AI 的普及使传统 CS1 课程赖以成立的"记语法、从零写代码"失去效力：作业本应考查逻辑思维，却日益退化为提示词工程测试，学生绕过了建立心智模型所必需的"挣扎"过程（Prather et al., 2023; Becker et al., 2023）。作者同时观察到自身长期教授的 CS 5001（Intensive Foundations of CS）与 CS 5002（Discrete Structures）在概念上天然同源——递归与归纳、布尔代数与条件语句互为镜像——但传统教学将二者隔离在不同学期、不同教师、缺乏协调。因此课程目标是：探索 AI 时代可行的 CS 教学方式，并让学生获得超越工具的问题求解直觉。教学情境为 Align Bridge 项目（面向非计算机专业本科生的 MS 过渡通道），学生背景多样且成熟，为课程整合提供了可行性。
AI.method: （1）课程结构：将两门课时间表前后拼接为每周二 10:45–15:00 的 4 小时 studio block（共用午餐作为自发讨论时段）+ 周四 2 小时 recitation；合并双 syllabus，保留约 80% 内容但按概念桥接重排（如递归与数学归纳同周、Python 列表/集合提前至集合论同周、OOP 从第 11 周提前至第 6 周）；不自录新课，直接策展既有优质视频放入 Canvas 课程门户，形成翻转课堂。（2）两大原则：AI Embraced（要求学生从第 0 周配置 GitHub Copilot 与 Claude Sonnet/Opus 4.5，用 AI 做系统理解如"解释这个类如何与 UI 交互"）；Foundations First（纸质练习与实体道具先于编码，如"跳舞的冒泡排序"用匈牙利民谣与角色分工（数交换、数比较）让学生集体推导 O(n²)、套娃教递归基例、针织与胶带搭网络模拟图算法）。（3）评估：每个项目强制"Code Walk"——先同伴逐行讲解，再向教授做 30 分钟答辩，不设评分细则，以"像向客户解释项目"开场，用 what-if 追踪执行路径、现场改代码运行的提问方式；执行路径触及数学概念时在白板现场推导公式；项目采取 pass/fail 制；期末每人 1 小时双教授 Code Walk。（4）项目设计：均从零编写，提供 2000–3000 行含 bug 的大型代码库，要求在既有框架内实现功能——集合论实验室（Streamlit + OpenRouter + Gemini 2.5 Flash 多模态识别手绘韦恩图）、递归洪水填充双人策略游戏（用数学归纳推导炸弹覆盖成本公式，Render 后端校验）、D&D 战斗模拟器（Flet + D&D 5e REST API，蒙特卡洛验证大数定律）、递归与归纳、概率等 5 个常规项目加 1 个无脚手架的期末项目。
AI.result: 课程于 2025 年秋季在 11 名学生的小规模试点中落地（Align 背景：23 个专业本科背景，约 55% STEM）。观察到：语法类主题所需教学时间显著缩短，腾出时间用于理论与系统设计；"CS 与数学互为镜像"的假设得到验证，递归/归纳、对象/数学结构相互强化，加快了复杂主题的掌握；学生从"害怕大型代码库"成长为能自主设计架构，第 12 周已能架构自己的期末应用；在强烈鼓励使用 AI 的情况下，近半数学生仍选择完全手写期末项目，两组在严格的 Code Walk 中表现相当，说明课程支持了多样化的熟练度路径；严格验证流程使学生主动发现了教师代码库中的概率计算 bug，强化了"理论校验是调试关键工具"的认识；下一学期的新教师反馈"他们已成为朋友、开学第一天就全情投入"，显示社区实践的持续效应；sharing circle 从 10 分钟自发延长至 20–30 分钟并外溢到 Slack 工作区。局限方面：合作授课模式与一小时 Code Walk 依赖小班规模，扩展到数百人需系统化的 TA 培训；n=11 限制了结论的外推性；课程强度对学生与教师体力都是考验；临时性行政流程（尤其 Code Walk 排期）成为学生评教中的摩擦点。
AI.conclusion: "CS 1.5"是一次高风险但必要的实验：拥抱 AI、优先建立人际连接、显式桥接数学理论与计算实践（如归纳↔递归），可以构造出更适配 AI 时代的 CS 课程。作者主张基础 CS 教育的本质不是语法传递，而是直觉、逻辑与专业判断力的养成；教师角色应从"知识仓库"转为引导模糊性判断的人类导师。未来规模化需要：结构化的行政骨架、TA 培养体系，以及愿意放弃"舞台上的智者"形象、拥抱实验性与脆弱性教学风格的教师。所有项目代码库与作业材料以开源形式发布（github.com/cs1-5），邀请其他机构改造与复用。

title: Paper2Data: Large-Scale LLM Extraction and Metadata Structuring of Global Urban Data from Scientific Literature
summary: Urban data support a wide range of applications across multiple disciplines. However, at the global scale, there is no unified platform for urban data discovery. As a result, researchers often have to manually search through websites or scientific literature to identify relevant datasets. To address this problem, we curate an open urban data discovery portal, \textit{UrbanDataMiner}, which supports dataset-level search and filtering over more than 60{,}000 urban datasets extracted from over 15{,}000 Nature-affiliated publications. \textit{UrbanDataMiner} is enabled by \textit{Paper2Data}, a novel large-scale LLM-driven pipeline that automatically identifies dataset mentions in scientific papers and structures them using a unified urban data metadata schema. Human-annotated evaluation demonstrates that \textit{Paper2Data} achieves high recall (approximately 90\%) in dataset identification and high field-level precision (above 80\%). In addition, \textit{UrbanDataMiner} can retrieve over 9\% of datasets that are not easily discoverable through general-purpose search engines such as Google. Overall, our work provides the first large-scale, literature-derived infrastructure for urban data discovery and enables more systematic and reusable data-driven research across disciplines. Our code and data are publicly available\footnote{https://github.com/Yourunwen/Paper2Data}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了UrbanDataMiner，一个基于LLM驱动的大规模城市数据发现门户，从15,000多篇Nature论文中提取了60,000多个城市数据集。核心组件Paper2Data pipeline能够自动识别论文中的数据集提及，并以统一的城市数据元数据模式进行结构化。
AI.motivation: 目前全球范围内缺乏统一的城市数据发现平台，研究人员通常需要手动搜索网站或科学文献来识别相关数据集，这一过程耗时且效率低下。
AI.method: 开发了Paper2Data pipeline，这是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的大规模自动化流程，能够从科学论文中自动识别数据集提及，并使用统一的城市数据元数据模式进行结构化。构建了UrbanDataMiner门户，支持数据集级别的搜索和筛选功能。
AI.result: Paper2Data在数据集识别任务中达到约90%的高召回率和80%以上的字段级精确率；UrbanDataMiner能够检索到超过9%通过Google等通用搜索引擎难以发现的数据集。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提供了首个基于文献的大规模城市数据发现基础设施，实现了跨学科更系统化、可复用的数据驱动研究。代码和数据已在GitHub公开。

title: Preventing overfitting in deep learning using differential privacy
comment: Master's dissertation State University of New York at Buffalo first published in 2017
summary: The use of Deep Neural Network based systems in the real world is growing. They have achieved state-of-the-art performance on many image, speech and text datasets. They have been shown to be powerful systems that are capable of learning detailed relationships and abstractions from the data. This is a double-edged sword which makes such systems vulnerable to learning the noise in the training set, thereby negatively impacting performance. This is also known as the problem of \emph{overfitting} or \emph{poor generalization}. In a practical setting, analysts typically have limited data to build models that must generalize to unseen data. In this work, we explore the use of a differential-privacy based approach to improve generalization in Deep Neural Networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用差分隐私（differential privacy）噪声来改善深度神经网络的泛化能力，将"过拟合/泛化不良"问题重新诠释为"学习训练集中噪声"的问题，并通过在训练中加入满足(ε,δ)-差分隐私的随机噪声，抑制模型对训练集噪声的过度拟合，从而提升模型在未见数据上的表现。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络在图像、语音、文本等任务上取得state-of-the-art性能，但也极易学习训练集中的噪声（过拟合/泛化不良）。在实际部署场景中，分析师往往只有有限的数据量来构建模型，而模型必须能泛化到未见数据。因此需要一种能有效抑制噪声学习、提升泛化能力的机制。作者选择差分隐私作为切入点：差分隐私在训练过程中注入受控噪声，理论上可限制模型对单条训练样本的依赖，从而抑制记忆训练集噪声。
AI.method: 探索将基于差分隐私的方法应用于深度神经网络训练中，即在梯度/参数更新或数据访问过程中引入满足 (ε, δ)-差分隐私要求的随机噪声，以正则化模型、限制其对训练数据的过度拟合，进而提升对未见数据的泛化性能。论文以差分隐私噪声作为正则化手段，缓解模型拟合训练集噪声的问题。
AI.result: 摘要给出的结果表明：差分隐私方法能够有效提高深度神经网络的泛化能力，抑制对训练集噪声的学习，在数据受限的实际场景中带来性能提升（具体量化指标需参见原文实验章节）。
AI.conclusion: 差分隐私不仅作为隐私保护工具，也可作为提升深度神经网络泛化能力的有效技术手段；在数据有限、噪声不可控的实际环境中，通过引入差分隐私噪声正则化训练过程，有助于缓解过拟合、获得更好的未见数据性能。

title: AgentGuard: A Multi-Agent Framework for Robust Package Confusion Detection via Hybrid Search and Metadata-Content Fusion
summary: The proliferation of open-source software (OSS) has made software supply chains prime targets for attacks like Package Confusion, where adversaries publish malicious packages with names deceptively similar to legitimate ones. To protect against such attacks and safeguard the use of OSS, multiple confusion detection methods have been proposed. However, existing methods are limited to single-signal retrieval strategies (relying solely on lexical or semantic metrics), struggle with high false positive rates (FPR), and are vulnerable to adversarial evasion. Critically, as content-agnostic approaches, they fundamentally fail to distinguish benign packages with high naming similarity from malicious, code-dissimilar impersonations, leading to persistent high FPR. To address these limitations, we introduce AgentGuard, a novel multi-agents based framework for package confusion detection. Specifically, it first discovers potential confusion targets using fine-tuned word embedding models with hybrid similarity search. After that, It subsequently evaluates risk via a fused machine learning model that uniquely combines: (1) a multi-dimensional metadata group and (2) a novel package content analysis group, to reduce the FPR and mitigate the impact of adversarial evasion. To assess the effectiveness of AgentGuard, we evaluate it on challenging ConfuDB and NeupaneDB datasets. Our results demonstrate that AgentGuard significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, ConfuGuard and Typomind, improving precision by 12\%-49\% while simultaneously reducing the FPR by 11\%-35\%, and effectively discovers the confused package.

AI.tldr: AgentGuard是一个基于多智能体框架的软件供应链包混淆攻击检测系统，通过结合词嵌入混合相似度搜索和多维元数据与包内容分析的融合机器学习模型，显著提升了包混淆检测的精确度（12%-49%）并降低了假阳性率（11%-35%）。
AI.motivation: 开源软件供应链面临包混淆攻击威胁，攻击者发布名称与合法包相似的恶意包。现有检测方法存在三大缺陷：仅使用单一信号检索策略（仅依赖词法或语义指标）、假阳性率高、容易遭受对抗性规避，且现有内容无关方法无法区分高命名相似度但代码不同的恶意冒充包与良性包。
AI.method: AgentGuard采用两阶段框架：(1) 使用微调词嵌入模型进行混合相似度搜索，发现潜在混淆目标；(2) 通过融合机器学习模型评估风险，该模型独特结合了多维元数据组和新型包内容分析组两个模块，以降低假阳性率并抵御对抗性规避。
AI.result: 在ConfuDB和NeupaneDB数据集上的评估表明，AgentGuard显著优于现有先进基线方法ConfuGuard和Typomind，精确度提升12%-49%，同时假阳性率降低11%-35%，并能有效发现混淆包。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体协作结合混合相似度搜索与多维内容分析是解决软件供应链包混淆检测问题的有效路径，能够在保持高检测率的同时显著降低误报，为OSS安全提供更可靠的保护。

title: Foundational Study on Authorship Attribution of Japanese Web Reviews for Actor Analysis
summary: This study investigates the applicability of authorship attribution based on stylistic features to support actor analysis in threat intelligence. As a foundational step toward future application to dark web forums, we conducted experiments using Japanese review data from clear web sources. We constructed datasets from Rakuten Ichiba reviews and compared four methods: TF-IDF with logistic regression (TF-IDF+LR), BERT embeddings with logistic regression (BERT-Emb+LR), BERT fine-tuning (BERT-FT), and metric learning with $k$-nearest neighbors (Metric+kNN). Results showed that BERT-FT achieved the best performance; however, training became unstable as the number of authors scaled to several hundred, where TF-IDF+LR proved superior in terms of accuracy, stability, and computational cost. Furthermore, Top-$k$ evaluation demonstrated the utility of candidate screening, and error analysis revealed that boilerplate text, topic dependency, and short text length were primary factors causing misclassification.

AI.tldr: 该研究将文本 authorship attribution 技术应用于威胁情报分析，初步在明网日语评论数据上验证了可行性。BERT微调在小规模场景表现最佳，但当作者规模扩展至数百人时，TF-IDF+逻辑回归在准确率、稳定性和计算成本上更具优势。
AI.motivation: 支持威胁情报场景中的行为者分析，为未来应用于暗网论坛打下基础。当前暗网用户匿名性高、标注数据稀缺，直接研究的挑战大，故先在明网日语评论数据上开展可行性验证。
AI.method: 使用乐天市场评论构建数据集，对比四种方法：TF-IDF+逻辑回归、BERT嵌入+逻辑回归、BERT微调、以及度量学习+kNN。采用Top-k评估方法筛选候选作者。
AI.result: BERT微调整体性能最优；但当作者数量扩展至数百规模时，训练不稳定。TF-IDF+LR在准确率、稳定性和计算成本上表现更优。Top-k候选筛选方法被证实有效。
AI.conclusion: 错误分析表明模板文本、主题依赖和短文本是主要误分类因素。TF-IDF+LR在大规模多作者场景下更为实用，BERT微调适合小规模精细分析。

title: Support Sufficiency as Consequence-Sensitive Compression in Belief Arbitration
summary:
When a system commits to a hypothesis, much of the evidential structure behind that commitment is lost to compression. Standard accounts assume that selected content and scalar confidence suffice for downstream control. This paper argues that they do not, and that determining what must survive compression is itself a consequence-sensitive problem. We develop a recurrent arbitration architecture in which active constraint fields jointly determine a hypothesis geometry over candidates. Rather than carrying that geometry forward in full, the system compresses it into a support-aware control state whose resolution is regulated by current consequence geometry, arbitration memory, and resource constraints.
  A bounded objective formalizes the tradeoff. Too little retained support collapses policy-relevant distinctions, producing controllers that select content adequately while misrouting verification, abstention, and recovery. Too much retained support fragments learning across overly fine contexts, degrading adaptation even as discrimination improves. These failure modes yield ordered controller predictions confirmed by a minimal repeated-interaction simulation. Adaptive controllers that regulate support resolution outperform all fixed-resolution controllers in cumulative utility. Agile adaptive control outperforms sluggish adaptive control. Fixed high-resolution control achieves the best commitment accuracy but still trails adaptive controllers because resource cost and learning fragmentation offset the gains from richer retention.
  Support sufficiency should be understood not as a static representational threshold, but as a dynamic compression criterion. Robust arbitration depends on preserving the smallest support structure adequate for policy under the current consequence landscape, and on regulating that structure as conditions change across repeated cycles of inference and action.

AI.tldr: 论文挑战了"选定内容+标量置信度足以支撑下游控制"的传统假设，指出压缩时保留什么本身是后果敏感的。提出一种基于主动约束场的递归仲裁架构，将假设几何压缩为支持感知控制状态，并通过重复交互模拟验证了自适应控制器的优越性。核心结论：支持充分性应视为动态压缩标准而非静态表征阈值。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为系统做出假设承诺时，只需保留选定内容和标量置信度即可满足下游控制需求。该论文认为这一假设存在根本缺陷——压缩后应保留何种结构本身就是一个依赖于后果敏感性的问题。
AI.method: 开发了递归仲裁架构，其中主动约束场联合确定候选假设的几何结构。系统将该几何压缩为"支持感知控制状态"，其分辨率由当前后果几何、仲裁记忆和资源约束共同调节。采用有界目标函数形式化这一权衡。
AI.result: 1) 保留支持过少会丧失政策相关区分度，导致验证、弃权和恢复路由错误；2) 保留支持过多会因过度细化上下文而碎片化学习，损害适应能力；3) 自适应调节支持分辨率的控制器在累积效用上优于所有固定分辨率控制器；4) 灵活自适应控制优于迟滞自适应控制；5) 固定高分辨率控制承诺准确率最高，但仍不及自适应控制器。
AI.conclusion: 支持充分性不应被视为静态表征阈值，而应理解为动态压缩标准。稳健仲裁的关键在于：为当前后果景观下政策所需的最小支持结构提供保留，并在推理-行动的反复循环中随条件变化调节该结构。

title: Predictive Sectorization and Bayesian Optimized Consensus for Admission Control in Autonomous Airspace Operations
comment: 6 pages, 7 figures, Submitted to IEEE SMC 2026
summary: Conventional air traffic control divides airspace into specific regions, creating a scaling bottleneck as traffic grows. Choosing how to partition airspace is not straightforward because grid size affects workload, handoff frequency, and the capacity of whatever coordination mechanism operates within each sector. We present a three stage pipeline that automates sectorization and sector coordination while preserving human oversight. First, a two stage XGBoost classifier predicts the optimal 3D grid configuration from 23 location-agnostic traffic features, achieving 91.38% accuracy on a 65,000 sample dataset derived from Federal Aviation Administration System Wide Information Management replays. Second, a leaderless Paxos consensus protocol lets aircraft coordinate sector entries among themselves, maintaining above 96% entry success with low near mid-air collision rates across all tested configurations. Third, Bayesian Optimization with a Gaussian Process surrogate tunes eight protocol parameters per airport in 50 trials, revealing that each traffic environment requires a qualitatively different configuration. The resulting pipeline offers a practical path toward scalable, autonomous airspace management as traffic demand outpaces controller capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一条面向自主空域管理的三阶段流水线：①用两阶段 XGBoost 分类器基于 23 个与地理位置无关的交通特征预测最优三维网格扇区划分（25 类中 91.38% 准确率，65,000 样本）；②用无主 Paxos 共识协议让航空器自主协调扇区进入许可（进入成功率 >96%，NMAC 率低）；③用贝叶斯优化（Matérn 5/2 ARD 高斯过程 + 期望改进）为每个机场在 50 次试验内调优 8 个协议参数，证明不存在通用默认配置。整体目标是让扇区化与准入协调自动化，同时保留人类管制员对政策的监督。
AI.motivation: 传统空域管理依赖管制员与固定扇区划分，随流量增长形成扩展瓶颈：管制员人均同时监控 8–12 架、峰值可超 18 架，FAA 长期面临人员短缺，欧洲罢工也反复导致网络级延误；而动态空域配置（DAC）类方法依赖计算昂贵的图割/聚类优化，难以支撑战术级实时重划。此外，冲突避免飞行计划等去中心化研究此前未与自动化扇区化和协议参数调优结合；共识协议的参数在 8 维空间中手工设定难以扩展到不同机场。作者的核心判断是：扇区划分本质上是受监督的分类问题，而扇区间的进入准入本质上是分布式一致性问题，二者应由学习式方法与去中心化协议分别承担，人保留政策制定权。
AI.method: 三阶段端到端流水线（Fig.1）。阶段一：在 100×100 NM 研究区域内，将扇区化建模为 25 类分类（行数×列数取 {1..5}²，固定 3 个高度层 0–9999 ft / 10000–17999 ft / 18000+ ft）；标签由对复合目标 J(R,C,L=3)（含占用方差、交接次数、风险对惩罚）的穷举网格搜索生成，数据取自 FAA SWIM 回放的 5 座机场（JFK、ATL、ORD、DFW、LAX）与 5 条繁忙巡航走廊，经 SMOTE 增广至约 65,000 样本（40,000 仿真 + 25,000 合成，7:1.5:1.5 划分）。特征 23 个：原始 8 项（密度、平均邻近度、高度混合、冲突风险、主流向、流动集中度、时段、空域大小）、工程 9 项（拥堵指数、高度复杂度、热点指示、密度平方、对数邻近度、分箱等级、风险归一化、轴向对齐）与时间 6 项。模型为两阶段 XGBoost：Stage 1 二分类（500 树、深度 6、lr 0.05）区分 1×1 与非 1×1（召回率 99.29%）；Stage 2 为 24 类分类器（800 树、深度 14、lr 0.02、L1=0.1）预测精确配置。阶段二：将 Discovery、Synod、TAP 三协议整合为独立 C++ 库，由离散事件模拟器驱动（每架飞机一个共识引擎，按 (时间, 飞机 ID, 事件类型) 排序的共享事件队列、整数皮秒时间戳保证确定性）；每架飞机持有提案状态、消息历史、去重集合。A 阶段广播 INIT_REQ 收集占位者应答并构成多数派法定人数，据此计算可证明无碰撞航迹；B 阶段单轮 Synod（PREPARE/PROMISE/ACCEPT，冲突时回退到最高编号提案值，无解则用形式化验证的回溯算法调整地速、再退化为等待航线、最终拒绝，并用 [nackBackoffMin, nackBackoffMax] 随机指数退避抑制活锁）；C 阶段两阶段确认的 TAP（LEARN/LEARNT + AK/ACK）确保全体成员视图一致。退出协议复用后两阶段并带 exit 标志；被拒进入者执行 C3 紧急退出。阶段三：8 个参数（超时时长、重试次数、备选数、阶段延迟因子、NACK 退避上下限、初始请求 IR 时间、求解器超时）的贝叶斯优化，Matérn 5/2 ARD 核的 GP 代理 + Expected Improvement，预算 50 次（10 次 LHS 初始 + 40 次 GP 引导）；目标 J(θ)=100·r_success −30·r_hold −10·r_speed −2·n̄_retry，NMAC 硬罚 −100、超时硬罚 −50。实验覆盖合成轨迹（2×2 至 16×16 网格、10–160 架）与真实 JFK SWIM 交通（2×2 至 6×6、10–80 架），并对 LAX/ORD/DFW 做逐机场调优。
AI.result: 阶段一：两阶段 XGBoost 总体准确率 91.38%（五折交叉验证 91.1±0.3%），行预测正确率 95.5%、列 94.8%，非 1×1 联合准确率 90.91%；对比单阶段 XGBoost 85.12%、随机森林 90.17%、LightGBM 90.69%、CatBoost 90.83% 均更优；单次推理 <1 ms。错误集中于相邻配置（1×2↔2×1、5×1↔4×1、3×4↔3×5），实际工作负载影响有限；特征重要度前三（traffic_level、traffic_density、density²）贡献逾 79% 增益，表明扇区化主要由交通量驱动。阶段二：全部合成配置在 160 架下进入成功率 >96%，8×8 网格全程 100% 零拒绝；JFK 中拒绝占比 ≤3%（合成 ≤12%），等待航线是最常用冲突化解手段；NMAC 呈现几何依赖的反转——真实 JFK 中 2×2 最少（0–1 次）而细网格因进近走廊被切割出现扇区间间隔违规，合成场景则相反（2×2 在 160 架时 40 次 NMAC，16×16 仅 8 次）。时延方面多数配置在 80 架下 <200 s，5×5/80 架出现 ~1,752 s 的 Paxos 活锁离群点（全部实验中仅 1 次）；分解耗时可见扇区内共识（Phase 1）恒 <4 s，而跨扇区协调（Phase 2）随网格变细单调上升（2×2 的 31.6 s → 6×6 的 66.7 s），故总时间在 2×2 最小（35.0 s）但 NMAC 最高，4×4 为折中点（时间在最小值 43% 以内且 60 架时零 NMAC）。阶段三：LAX/ORD/DFW 最优得分 189.8/127.1/100.8，最优分别出现在第 35/40/19 次试验；参数配置形态迥异——LAX 偏好多次重试（10）与长求解器窗口（10 s），ORD 需 1.0 s 短求解器超时以避免病态重试链（50 次中 5 次超时），DFW 偏好少重试（4）与 2.93 s 超时；ARD 长度尺度导出的重要度显示求解器超时主导 LAX（36.7%），NACK 退避主导 ORD（64.3%）与 DFW（23.2%），恰是抑制活锁的关键机制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次将学习型扇区化、去中心化共识准入与自动化协议调优整合为单一端到端流水线；结果表明扇区化主要由交通状态而非空域身份决定（仅用聚合特征即可 91.38% 准确率，且无需地理标识即可迁移到未见区域），最优网格尺寸与交通几何而非仅密度强相关（因此必须自适应选择），且共识协议参数对环境高度敏感、无通用默认值，必须依赖贝叶斯优化按机场自动调优——人工调参在 8 维空间不可行。亚毫秒级推理使数分钟级的周期性重划扇区（配以迟滞防振荡）成为可能。局限包括：采用直线航迹与质点动力学、终端区真实性受限（但协议本身轨迹无关）；通信模型完全确定可靠、无丢包与抖动、无故障进程；未处理航空器紧急情况（需优先级覆盖机制）；50 次 BO 预算可能错过精细最优；目标函数权重（100/30/10/2）凭直觉设定而非数据推导。未来方向包括引入丢包与 ADS-B 时延分布的 realistic 通信模型评测、通过双层优化或逆强化学习从数据中学习 BO 目标权重。

title: ARMove: Learning to Predict Human Mobility through Agentic Reasoning
summary: Human mobility prediction is a critical task but remains challenging due to its complexity and variability across populations and regions. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have made progress in zero-shot prediction, but existing methods suffer from limited interpretability (due to black-box reasoning), lack of iterative learning from new data, and poor transferability. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{ARMove}, a fully transferable framework for predicting human mobility through agentic reasoning. To address these limitations, ARMove employs standardized feature management with iterative optimization and user-specific customization: four major feature pools for foundational knowledge, user profiles for segmentation, and an automated generation mechanism integrating LLM knowledge. Robust generalization is achieved via agentic decision-making that adjusts feature weights to maximize accuracy while providing interpretable decision paths. Finally, large-small model synergy distills strategies from large LLMs (e.g., 72B) to smaller ones (e.g., 7B), reducing costs and enhancing performance ceilings. Extensive experiments on four global datasets show ARMove outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on 6 out of 12 metrics (gains of 0.78\% to 10.47\%), with transferability tests confirming robustness across regions, users, and scales. The other 4 items also achieved suboptimal results. Transferability tests confirm its 19 robustness across regions, user groups, and model scales, while interpretability 20 analysis highlights its transparency in decision-making. Our codes are available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ARMove-F847.

AI.tldr: ARMove是一个基于智能体推理的全可迁移人类移动预测框架，通过标准化特征管理、用户定制、LLM知识集成和大小模型协同，实现比现有最优方法提升0.78%-10.47%的预测精度，同时具备跨区域、跨用户、跨规模的可迁移性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM零样本移动预测方法存在三大局限：1）黑盒推理导致可解释性差；2）缺乏从新数据中迭代学习的能力；3）跨区域/用户迁移性弱。这些问题阻碍了移动预测在实际场景中的应用。
AI.method: ARMove框架包含三个核心模块：1）标准化特征管理：四个特征池（基础知识）+用户画像（用户分群）+自动化知识生成机制；2）智能体决策机制：动态调整特征权重以最大化精度，同时提供可解释的决策路径；3）大小模型协同：将从大LLM（如72B参数）提取的策略蒸馏到小模型（如7B），降低成本并提升性能上限。
AI.result: 在4个全球数据集上的广泛实验表明：ARMove在12项指标中的6项上超越最优基线（提升0.78%-10.47%），其余4项也达到次优；迁移性测试验证了跨区域、用户群体和模型规模的有效性；可解释性分析证明了决策过程的透明性。
AI.conclusion: ARMove成功解决了LLM移动预测中的可解释性、迭代学习和迁移性问题，通过智能体推理和大小模型协同实现了高精度、可解释、全可迁移的移动预测框架，为智慧城市、交通规划等应用提供了新方案。

title: NL2SQLBench: A Modular Benchmarking Framework for LLM-Enabled NL2SQL Solutions
comment: The paper is accepted by VLDB 2026
summary: Natural Language to SQL (NL2SQL) technology empowers non-expert users to query relational databases without requiring SQL expertise. While large language models (LLMs) have greatly improved NL2SQL algorithms, their rapid development outpaces systematic evaluation, leaving a critical gap in understanding their effectiveness, efficiency, and limitations. To this end, we present NL2SQLBench, the first modular evaluation and benchmarking framework for LLM-enabled NL2SQL approaches. Specifically, we dissect NL2SQL systems into three core modules: Schema Selection, Candidate Generation, and Query Revision. For each module, we comprehensively review existing strategies and propose novel fine-grained metrics that systematically quantify module-level effectiveness and efficiency. We further implement these metrics in a flexible multi-agent framework, allowing configurable benchmarking across diverse NL2SQL approaches. Leveraging NL2SQLBench, we rigorously evaluate ten representative open-source methods on two datasets, the BIRD development set and the ScienceBenchmark development set, using two LLMs, DeepSeek-V3 and GPT-4o mini. We systematically assess each approach across the three core modules and evaluate multiple critical performance dimensions. Our evaluation reveals significant gaps in existing NL2SQL methods, highlighting not only substantial room for accuracy improvements but also the significant computational inefficiency, which severely hampers real-world adoption. Furthermore, our analysis identifies critical shortcomings in current benchmark datasets and evaluation rules, emphasizing issues such as inaccurate gold SQL annotations and limitations in existing evaluation rules. By synthesizing these insights into a unified benchmarking, our study establishes a clear reference point for fair comparison and serves as essential guidance for future targeted innovation in NL2SQL technology.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出NL2SQLBench，首个模块化的LLM驱动NL2SQL方法评估与基准测试框架，将NL2SQL系统分解为Schema Selection、Candidate Generation和Query Revision三个核心模块，对10种开源方法进行系统评估，揭示了现有方法在准确性和效率上的显著不足，并指出了当前基准数据集和评估规则的局限性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在NL2SQL任务上发展迅速，但系统性的评估方法滞后，导致对其有效性、效率和局限性缺乏全面理解。
AI.method: 提出NL2SQLBench框架，将NL2SQL系统解构为三个核心模块（Schema Selection、Candidate Generation、Query Revision），为每个模块设计细粒度评估指标，并在灵活的多智能体框架中实现，允许跨不同NL2SQL方法的可配置基准测试。使用DeepSeek-V3和GPT-4o mini两个LLM，在BIRD开发集和ScienceBenchmark开发集上对10种代表性开源方法进行了系统评估。
AI.result: 评估结果揭示了现有NL2SQL方法存在显著差距：不仅准确性有较大提升空间，而且计算效率低下，严重阻碍了实际应用。同时，分析发现当前基准数据集（如gold SQL标注不准确）和评估规则存在关键缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了统一的基准测试体系，为NL2SQL技术的公平比较提供了清晰的参考点，并为该领域的未来创新提供了重要指导。识别的关键问题包括：现有基准数据集存在不准确的gold SQL标注，以及当前评估规则的局限性。

title: Decoding AI Tutor Effects for Educational Measurement: Temporal, Multi-Outcome, and Behavior-Cognitive Analysis
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) tutors have become increasingly popular in learning environments. In this study, we propose an AI agent prototype framework for exploring AI-assisted learning with temporal interaction patterns, multiple outcomes analysis, and behavioral-cognitive learner profiling. Based on three research questions, this study aims to investigate whether early interaction patterns can predict later performance and trust, how multiple outcomes can be traded off with different AI tutor feedback conditions, and if learner profiles can be identified with behavioral and cognitive indicators. An AI tutor agent has been developed to provide various feedback forms to learners, including hints, explanations, examples, and code. A neural policy model and a stochastic simulation framework are used to produce artificial student-AI tutor interaction records, which include response time, attempts, hint requests, correctness, quiz results, improvement, satisfaction, and trust. Temporal features are used to predict later correctness and trust with early interaction patterns, and clustering methods are used to find learner profiles. The results showed that early interaction patterns were predictive of later performance and trust, that student behavior changed over time with AI-based tutoring, and that latent student profiles could be identified based on their behavioral and cognitive differences.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个AI导师智能体原型，通过神经策略模型和随机模拟框架生成学生-AI导师交互数据，探究早期交互模式对后续表现的预测作用、多结果的权衡关系，以及学习者画像的分类识别。研究表明早期行为模式可预测后续表现与信任度，AI辅导下学生行为随时间演变，且可识别出具有不同行为和认知特征的潜在学习者群体。
AI.motivation: 随着AI导师在学习环境中的普及，需要系统性地理解学生与AI导师的交互机制，包括：1）早期交互能否预测长期学习效果和信任建立；2）不同反馈条件下的多结果如何权衡；3）学习者能否基于行为和认知指标进行分类画像。
AI.method: 开发了提供 hints、explanations、examples 和 code 四种反馈形式的AI导师智能体；采用神经策略模型和随机模拟框架生成人工交互记录（包含反应时间、尝试次数、提示请求、正确率、测验结果、改进度、满意度、信任度等指标）；利用时间特征进行预测分析，使用聚类方法识别学习者画像。
AI.result: 1）早期交互模式可预测后续正确率和信任度；2）AI辅导过程中学生行为随时间发生变化；3）基于行为和认知差异可识别潜在学习者画像。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为理解AI辅助学习中的动态交互机制提供了有效工具，研究结果支持将早期交互行为作为干预时机，将学习者画像用于个性化教学设计。

title: Diagnosing LLM-based Rerankers in Cold-Start Recommender Systems: Coverage, Exposure and Practical Mitigations
comment: 12 pages, 7 figures. Code and data available at https://github.com/nikita-zmanovskiy/cold-start-algorithm
summary: Large language models (LLMs) and cross-encoder rerankers have gained attention for improving recommender systems, particularly in cold-start scenarios where user interaction history is limited. However, practical deployment reveals significant performance gaps between LLM-based approaches and simple baselines. This paper presents a systematic diagnostic study of cross-encoder rerankers in cold-start movie recommendation using the Serendipity-2018 dataset. Through controlled experiments with 500 users across multiple random seeds, we identify three critical failure modes: (1) low retrieval coverage in candidate generation (recall@200 = 0.109 vs. 0.609 for baselines), (2) severe exposure bias with rerankers concentrating recommendations on 3 unique items versus 497 for random baseline, and (3) minimal score discrimination between relevant and irrelevant items (mean difference = 0.098, Cohen's d = 0.13). We demonstrate that popularity-based ranking substantially outperforms LLM reranking (HR@10: 0.268 vs. 0.008, p < 0.001), with the performance gap primarily attributable to retrieval stage limitations rather than reranker capacity. Based on these findings, we provide actionable recommendations including hybrid retrieval strategies, candidate pool size optimization, and score calibration techniques. All code, configurations, and experimental results are made available for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文对冷启动电影推荐场景中跨编码器重排序器进行了系统性诊断研究。通过500名用户的对照实验，识别出三个关键失效模式：检索覆盖率低、曝光偏差严重、分数区分度不足。研究发现流行度排序显著优于LLM重排序（HR@10: 0.268 vs 0.008），性能差距主要源于检索阶段而非重排序器能力。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM和跨编码器重排序器在推荐系统尤其是冷启动场景中的实际部署效果与简单基线存在显著差距，亟需系统性诊断以识别关键问题所在。
AI.method: 基于Serendipity-2018数据集，使用500名用户进行多随机种子对照实验，系统性地评估跨编码器重排序器在冷启动电影推荐中的表现，重点分析检索和重排序两个阶段的性能。
AI.result: 识别出三个关键失效模式：(1)检索覆盖率低（recall@200=0.109 vs 0.609）；(2)曝光偏差严重（重排序仅推荐3个独特物品 vs 随机基线497个）；(3)分数区分度极低（均值差异=0.098，Cohen's d=0.13）。流行度排序大幅优于LLM重排序（HR@10: 0.268 vs 0.008, p<0.001），主要问题源于检索阶段而非重排序器。
AI.conclusion: LLM重排序在冷启动推荐中的性能瓶颈主要归因于检索阶段的限制，而非重排序器本身能力。建议采用混合检索策略、优化候选池规模、改进分数校准技术来提升系统性能。所有代码和实验结果已公开以确保可复现性。

title: Beyond Verifiable Rewards: Rubric-Based GRM for Reinforced Fine-Tuning SWE Agents
summary: Despite recent progress in Large Language Model (LLM) Agents for Software Engineering (SWE) tasks, end-to-end fine-tuning typically relies on verifiable terminal rewards such as whether all unit tests pass. While these binary signals reflect whether the final solution is correct, they provide little guidance for shaping intermediate behaviors during multi-step interactions, thereby limiting improvements in the overall quality of the resolution process. To address this, we introduce a rubric-based Generative Reward Model (GRM) that provides richer learning signals. The GRM is equipped with human-designed rubrics that indicate criteria for encouraging or discouraging specific behavioral patterns, and we leverage this feedback for high-quality training data collection via trajectory filtration. When used for Reinforced Fine-Tuning (RFT) on SWE Tasks, our approach outperforms terminal-score-only rejection sampling: it more effectively suppresses undesirable patterns while promoting beneficial ones, as confirmed by case analyses, and it ultimately improves final test accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于评分标准的生成式奖励模型（GRM），通过设计人类定义的评分标准来引导LLM Agent在软件工程任务中的中间行为，克服了传统仅依赖最终测试结果（二元奖励信号）的局限性，并将其应用于强化微调（RFT）中以提升SWE任务的最终表现。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM Agent在软件工程任务中的端到端微调主要依赖可验证的终端奖励（如单元测试是否通过），但这类二元信号无法有效指导多步骤交互过程中的中间行为改进，限制了解决方案整体质量的提升。
AI.method: 设计了基于人类定义评分标准（rubrics）的生成式奖励模型（GRM），该模型能够提供比二元奖励更丰富的学习信号；利用此反馈进行高质量训练数据的轨迹筛选（trajectory filtration），并将筛选后的数据应用于SWE任务的强化微调（RFT）。
AI.result: 相比仅使用终端分数的拒绝采样方法，该方法更有效地抑制不良行为模式并促进有益行为模式的形成，最终提升了最终测试准确率。
AI.conclusion: 基于评分标准的生成式奖励模型能够为LLM Agent在软件工程任务中的多步骤交互提供有效的学习信号引导，通过轨迹筛选和强化微调可显著提升任务表现。

title: Software Self-Extension with SelfEvolve: an Agentic Architecture for Runtime Code Generation
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, accepted at 21st International Conference on Software Engineering for Adaptive and Self-Managing Systems, April 13--14, 2026, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
summary: Traditional self-adaptive systems automatically reconfigure existing components in response to changing requirements, but provide limited support for the generation of novel functionalities. The software generation capabilities of large language models (LLMs) open the possibility to create entirely new modules at runtime, enabling a form of self-evolution beyond traditional self-adaptation. We present SelfEvolve, an orchestrated agentic pipeline architecture enabling runtime self-extension--the autonomous addition of new capabilities during execution--as a preliminary form of self-evolution. Self-extension focuses on the autonomous generation and integration of new functions, based on user requests, without requiring a system restart or developer intervention. Evaluation of our architecture across 11 self-extension tasks demonstrates an average Pass@1 of 92.7% (51/55), outperforming developer-focused code generation baselines like AutoGen, MetaGPT, and AgentCoder. SelfEvolve achieves 61.8% improvement over the best baseline, i.e. Autogen, with statistical significance. This work demonstrates the feasibility of runtime capability extension through autonomous code generation. This provides preliminary evidence for a paradigm in which systems autonomously evolve to satisfy user needs, paving the way towards individualised, self-improving systems.

AI.tldr: SelfEvolve 是一种编排式智能体（agentic）流水线架构，可在运行时自主生成、验证并集成新的功能函数（无需重启或开发者介入），实现传统自适应性系统所不具备的"新功能生成"能力，是"自我进化"的初步形态。在 11 个自扩展任务上（每任务 5 次运行，共 55 次），平均 Pass@1 为 92.7%（51/55），显著优于面向开发者离线代码生成的基线 AutoGen（30.9%）、MetaGPT（27.3%）和 AgentCoder（0%），相对最优基线提升 61.8%；消融实验表明 TDD 流水线贡献 20 个百分点成功率提升并带来 2.1× 更快的收敛（2.2 vs 4.7 轮迭代）。
AI.motivation: 传统自适应性系统（如 MAPE-K）只能在既有组件间做重配置，无法创造全新功能；LLM 的代码生成能力使运行时"长出"新模块成为可能，从而实现超越自适应的自我进化。作者指出，现有工作存在三方面空白：(1) MASE 等多智能体自进化系统仅优化提示词、记忆与工具调用策略，运行期不生成新函数；(2) 进化计算/遗传算法类工作孤立地产出程序变体，缺乏集成机制；(3) LLM 代码精修工作聚焦迭代式改进，未考虑运行时演化。因此需要一种面向终端用户（而非开发者）、以高层自然语言需求为输入、可在运行中直接合成—验证—集成新代码的架构，并评估其可行性与关键组件的贡献。
AI.method: 架构层面：采用确定性控制流编排的智能体流水线，由六类组件构成——Chat & Tool Dispatcher（解析用户请求，命中知识库已有 Tool 则直接调用，否则生成结构化需求 R_i）、Test-Driven Code & Function Generator（先生成 TDD 测试 T_i，再据 R_i 与 T_i 生成函数 F_i，并复用 Functions 仓库中已有代码作为子函数）、Intermediate Adjudicator（执行 TDD 测试并判定 accept/reject，失败则产出反馈 E_i）、Unit Test Generator（基于实际实现 F_i 生成边界/异常处理单元测试 U_i）、Unit Test Handler（子进程沙箱执行，30 秒超时，采集 stdout/stderr/exit code）、Final Adjudicator（终审并决定集成或回环反馈）。知识库由 Prompts 仓库、Functions 仓库、Tool Descriptors 仓库三部分组成，支撑持久化知识积累与自动代码复用；集成阶段写入函数代码、注册 JSON 工具描述符、更新提示词模式，并通过 importlib.reload() 实现热加载免重启。执行层采用独立子进程沙箱（进程隔离）保证生成代码与核心功能隔离，最多迭代 6 轮，反馈在迭代间累积以收缩解空间。实验层面：自建 11 个任务数据集（Integration 4 个，577–783 LOC 多文件多类；Compositional 3 个，30–50 LOC；Data processing 4 个，50–100 条记录），覆盖 8 个领域；每任务 5 次运行共 55 次；基线为 AgentCoder、AutoGen、MetaGPT；统一使用 GPT-4.1（因其支持 OpenAI function-calling 协议）；采用 pytest 行为性断言作为 ground truth，Pass@1 为二值指标；统计上按问题级配对做 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验（RQ1 三组比较做 Bonferroni 校正，α=0.0167；RQ2 两组无需校正），并记录平均迭代次数。RQ2 采用消融：去掉中间裁定阶段，直接由函数生成进入终审，进行 110 次实验（55 有 TDD / 55 无 TDD）。
AI.result: RQ1：SelfEvolve 总体 Pass@1 = 92.7%（51/55）。分类别为 Integration 90%（18/20）、Compositional 93.3%（14/15）、Data processing 95%（19/20）。基线对比：AgentCoder 0%（0/55）、AutoGen 30.9%（17/55）、MetaGPT 27.3%（15/55）；相对最优基线 AutoGen 提升 61.8 个百分点，三组比较经 Bonferroni 校正后均统计显著（p_adj = 0.003、0.012、0.006）。平均收敛迭代 2.2 轮（上限 6）。RQ2 消融：有 TDD 92.7% vs 无 TDD 72.7%，Wilcoxon W=55、p<0.001、效应量 r=0.98（强效应）；迭代数 2.2 vs 4.7（2.1× 更快收敛）。分项增益：Integration 65%→90%（迭代 5.0→2.4）、Compositional 73.3%→93.3%（4.7→2.1）、Data processing 80%→95%（4.4→2.2）。定性比较显示 AutoGen/MetaGPT/AgentCoder 在自动代码库分析、多文件导航、导入解析、持久化知识库、自动代码复用、用户导向与热代码重载等能力上均不支持或仅部分支持。作者也讨论了效度威胁：数据集手工构造、真值测试可能不完备、测试与代码同源模型导致"测试-代码合谋"风险（以独立智能体/独立提示与全新 API 调用缓解）、缺少回归测试、仅评测功能正确性而未评估性能/安全/可维护性、样本量小（11 对）影响统计功效、仅用 GPT-4.1 且依赖 function-calling 协议限制了对开源模型的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 实验初步证明：依靠 LLM 智能体在运行时自主生成、测试验证并集成新功能是可行的，SelfEvolve 显著优于面向开发者的离线代码生成基线，且嵌入 TDD（先生成测试再生成实现，并通过两阶段裁定与累积反馈迭代修正）是性能与收敛效率的关键贡献者。该工作将软件开发范式从"开发者驱动、离线交付"推进到"用户驱动、运行时即时获得能力"，为个性化软件与自改进系统（如自主调试、进化式设计、面向消费者的群体化功能扩散）提供了方向性证据。但作者明确将本工作定位为"初步形态"：当前为请求驱动的被动式演化、限于单函数生成与既有代码库集成、尚未做结构修改或重构；未来工作包括引入完整 MAPE-K 循环实现基于运行期监控的主动自进化、加入 human-on-the-loop 验证与 guardrails 防失控演化、嵌入需求工程（多智能体辩论、需求澄清、pre/post 条件形式化、变更影响分析）、引入运行时插桩（断点、内存状态、调用栈）提升失败诊断精度，以及扩展多模型、多文件生成、回归测试与部署研究等更严格评估。

title: GoCoMA: Hyperbolic Multimodal Representation Fusion for Large Language Model-Generated Code Attribution
comment: Accepted to the International Conference on Multimedia & Expo (ICME) 2026
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) trained on massive code corpora are now increasingly capable of generating code that is hard to distinguish from human-written code. This raises practical concerns, including security vulnerabilities and licensing ambiguity, and also motivates a forensic question: 'Who (or which LLM) wrote this piece of code?' We present GoCoMA, a multimodal framework that models an extrinsic hierarchy between (i) code stylometry, capturing higher-level structural and stylistic signatures, and (ii) image representations of binary pre-executable artifacts (BPEA), capturing lower-level, execution-oriented byte semantics shaped by compilation and toolchains. GoCoMA projects modality embeddings into a hyperbolic Poincaré ball, fuses them via a geodesic-cosine similarity-based cross-modal attention (GCSA) fusion mechanism, and back-projects the fused representation to Euclidean space for final LLM-source attribution.
