G-PARC achieves better accuracy with 2-3x fewer parameters than MeshGraphNet, MeshGraphKAN, and GraphSAGE, replacing the traditional encoder-processor-decoder framework with analytically computed differential operators. We demonstrate that G-PARC (1) generalizes across nonuniform spatial and temporal discretizations; (2) handles moving meshes required for structural deformation; and (3) outperforms existing graph-based PADL methods on nonlinear benchmarks including fluvial hydrology, planar shock waves, and elastoplastic dynamics. By embedding explicit physical operators within the flexibility of GNNs, G-PARC enables accurate modeling of extreme nonlinear phenomena on complex computational domains, moving PADLbeyond idealized Cartesian grids.

AI.tldr: G-PARC 首次将物理感知循环卷积网络(PARC)从规则笛卡尔网格推广到非结构化网格:用移动最小二乘(MLS)核在图上解析构造梯度与拉普拉斯算子,并把这些无学习参数的微分算子直接嵌入消息传递的计算图中,取代传统编码器-处理器-解码器框架。在河流洪水(不规则LiDAR地形网格)、平面激波(变时间步长)与弹塑性结构力学(变形网格)三个基准上,G-PARC 以 224K–285K 参数、每步 3–6 倍更少 FLOPs 超越 MeshGraphNet、MeshGraphKAN、GraphSAGE 等基线,并支持网格/时间步长/全局物理参数的非均匀泛化,成为可靠的物理信息代理求解器。
AI.motivation: PARC 类物理感知深度学习(PADL)通过把控制偏微分方程的微分算子直接嵌入网络计算图,在激波、间断、极端非线性等场景中表现优异,但其像素级卷积被限制在静态、均匀的笛卡尔网格与恒定时间采样上,难以处理不规则几何、局部化结构与变长时间步长。图神经网络(GNN)天然适配非欧几里得离散,但现有基于图的 PADL(MeshGraphNet、MeshGraphKAN、GraphSAGE、GNO/GINO、PINN/神经算子扩展)均为黑盒数据驱动:要么完全依赖消息传递隐式学习微分关系,长时自回归 rollout 会灾难性发散;要么继承 PINN 的收敛与域外泛化缺陷、神经算子的混叠误差与谱偏置,且计算代价高昂(GNO/GINO 的核积分变换需每步邻域搜索,单步达 14.9 s)。因此需要一个既能处理非结构化网格、移动网格与变步长,又保留显式物理可解释性、稳定长时预测且计算高效的架构。
AI.method: 总体框架:设状态场满足 ∂s/∂t = F(s,∇s,Δs) + R(s,c),用单一学习算子 Φ_θ 逼近。(1) MLS 微分算子:对每个节点 v_i,在邻域 N_i 上用一次多项式拟合求梯度 ∇s_i = M_i^{-1} g_i(M_i 为 2×2 矩阵,g_i 由边差分组装);用二次基向量 H_ij=[δx,δy,δx²,δy²,δxδy] 构造 5×5 矩阵 M̃_i,配合 L=∇²H=[0,0,2,2,0]ᵀ 得到拉普拉斯权重 w_ij = LᵀM̃_i^{-1}H_ij,从而 ∇²s = Σ w_ij(s_j − s_i)。所有权重只依赖网格几何,按拓扑预计算并缓存,零学习参数,类比非结构有限体积中的最小二乘梯度重构。(2) 网络结构:源项 R 由 GNN 近似,与 [s,∇s,∇²s] 拼接后送入 MLP 得 ds/dt;再由数值积分器(前向 Euler,亦可用 Heun/RK4)推进状态并自回归反馈。取消编码器-处理器-解码器结构。Δt、左态 ρ_L/p_L 等作为全局条件输入以支持变步长。(3) 训练:AdamW + 余弦退火,各数据集分别 100/200/1500 epochs,自由运行式自回归训练(弹性 K=16,其余 K=4),损失为全状态 L² 误差并对时间步平均,反传穿过数值积分。数据集:①HEC-RAS+USGS 的 Iowa River(约 2400 节点/9900 边)与 White River(约 4800 节点/19200 边)浅水方程洪水,1000 例(700/150/150);②Chord 四阶有限体积求解的 64×64 准一维激波管,500 例(400/25/75),Δt 跨 3.7 倍(3.84e-6 ~ 1.41e-5 s),测试集集中于参数空间极端;③PLAID 的 2D_ElPlDynamics 弹塑性数据集(OpenRadioss 求解,含单元侵蚀损伤),1000 例仅用 50/10/932 的小数据划分,网格拓扑逐例不同(25–32k 节点)。基线:MGKAN、MGNET、GraphSAGE(GNO/GINO 因显存不可行仅测算力)、消融版 G-PARC(w/o MLS)、激波管上另比 PARCv2。指标:RMSE、RRMSE、NMSE、SSIM、R²、CSI、NSE,含 AUC 与末时刻值。
AI.result: 三个基准上 G-PARC 全面最优。河流洪水:RRMSE AUC 0.208±0.106、NMSE AUC 0.070±0.070(较次优降低 31%)、SSIM 0.952、R² 0.909;NSE 0.9402、CSI 0.8330(重要节点 0.9176/0.8900);MGKAN 末步 RRMSE 0.319 更好但累计误差更大。激波管:所有指标第一,RRMSE AUC 0.0070(较 MGKAN 0.0555 降 7.9 倍)、末步 0.0121(较消融版 0.1222 降 10.1 倍)、NMSE AUC 1.0e-4(较 MGKAN 0.0393 低 265 倍)、SSIM AUC 0.9999、R² 0.9998;PARCv2 完全失效。弹塑性:RRMSE AUC 0.4391(较消融降 6.9%)、末步 0.4607(降 12.1%)、SSIM AUC 0.4346,且方差最小、跨拓扑泛化最稳;MGKAN 明显落后,MGNET/GraphSAGE 在三个基准均崩溃。计算效率:参数 224K–285K(少 2–3 倍),每步 FLOPs 少 3–6 倍;弹性算例吞吐 4.05M node·steps/s,为 GINO 的 604 倍、GNO 的 2383 倍,单步 6.5 ms vs GNO 14.9 s、显存 528 MB vs 8.3 GB;节点数增 6.1 倍时吞吐仅降 1.5 倍,基线降 2.8–3.3 倍。
AI.conclusion: G-PARC 是首个把 PARC 扩展到非欧几里得/非结构化网格的工作:通过 MLS 在消息传递框架内解析构造微分算子,使物理结构在任何网络权重作用之前即被嵌入表示,既保持可解释性又获得 8 倍量级精度提升、参数与 FLOPs 大幅下降,是"显式嵌入数值方法即带来稳定性与效率"的有力证据。其优势来源于归纳偏置而非优化调参:所有模型采用相同自回归训练方案,基线使用官方默认超参未额外调优。局限与未来方向:弹塑性数据集因单卡资源仅用 50 个训练样本(先前工作用 40 张 A100),提升空间显著;MLS 权重需按网格拓扑预计算(移动网格下需重算),初始化成本在弹性算例中被摊销计入单步耗时;消融结果显示不同领域基线强弱次序变化(消融版在拓扑变化大的结构力学上优于 MGKAN,而 MGKAN 更擅长对流扩散类问题);对多物理场耦合、更高维几何与三维网格的推广仍有待验证。

title: On the Use of Commit Messages for Corrective Software Maintenance: A Systematic Mapping Study
comment: Preprint. Accepted for publication at EASE 2026 (Track: Research Papers)
summary: Corrective maintenance is crucial to ensure the quality of software, thereby improving reliability and user experience. In a version control system (VCS), developers write commit messages to document their changes and support later maintenance. Still, to this day, no secondary study has mapped the research landscape of how commit messages have been used in corrective software maintenance. We present a systematic mapping study of 97 primary sources published between 2004 and May 2025, where we examine the goals, potential utilization of source code artifacts along with commit messages, methodologies, stakeholders, and the key findings about their influence on corrective maintenance. Our analysis reveals a growing interest in the usage of commit messages to perform corrective maintenance tasks, in particular for bug analysis and bug fix identification goals. Surprisingly few studies address other themes such as automated program repair, security development practices, etc. We find that the software artifacts most used in combination with commit messages are commit "diffs" and that repository mining, together with natural language processing (NLP) and artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML) are the methodological foundations of studies in this field. Among stakeholders considered in previous studies, developers play the most important role in shaping corrective maintenance practices. Key findings in previous studies about commit messages establish their significant role in corrective maintenance, due to the fact that they carry crucial information helpful for stakeholders to understand and improve the code base through the software evolution process. Often, though, commit messages lack important information and are not enough to convey the intent of code changes to future readers.

AI.tldr: 本文是首篇系统映射研究（systematic mapping study），梳理了2004年至2025年5月间97篇一级文献，系统刻画提交信息（commit messages）在纠正性软件维护（corrective maintenance）中的研究现状：研究热度持续上升（2022–2023年为峰值），目标以缺陷分析与缺陷修复识别为主，协作软件工件以commit diff/code changes为绝对核心（78篇），方法论以仓库挖掘（89篇）配合NLP（82篇）与AI/ML（72篇）为支柱，涉及的干系人以开发者（81篇）为主；核心结论是提交信息对缺陷预测、修复生成、补丁识别等任务价值显著，但普遍存在信息缺失、难以充分表达修改意图的问题。
AI.motivation: 纠正性维护（corrective maintenance）成本高昂、直接影响客户关系与软件公司收益，开发者必须理解代码变更才能定位并修复缺陷。在版本控制系统（VCS）中，commit message 是记录变更原因的关键载体，有时甚至是后续开发者理解变更的唯一信息来源。因此利用提交信息开展缺陷分析、预测、修复与补丁识别已成为工程实践与学术研究的常态。然而该领域的研究格局仍然碎片化：目标多样、工件与方法各异，缺少对"提交信息如何支撑纠正性维护"的系统性梳理，也无任何二次研究（secondary study）覆盖这一主题；同时工程实践中提交信息质量普遍不足、难以充分表达意图的问题也未被系统量化。本文的动机即为填补这一知识空白，绘制研究版图、评估提交信息在纠正性维护中的作用并指出未来研究方向。
AI.method: 采用Petersen等（2008, 2015）的系统映射研究方法，分三阶段：（1）制定6个研究问题——RQ1 发表时间与场所；RQ2 研究目标；RQ3 与提交信息搭配使用的软件工件；RQ4 研究方法论；RQ5 涉及的人类干系人；RQ6 关于提交信息影响纠正性维护的关键发现。（2）文献筛选：基于PICO框架（仅取Population与Intervention，Population=software/repository/project/application/code/github，Intervention=commit/message）构造检索式，在IEEE Xplore、ACM DL、Scopus、Springer、ScienceDirect、Wiley等数据库检索标题/摘要，得880篇；经标题与DOI去重及人工核查得484篇；标题/摘要筛选排除399篇，保留85篇；由两位作者协作进行全文筛选（第一作者标注，不确定项交由第二作者复核，因共识式评审未计算Kappa），保留59篇；再经三轮后向滚雪球补充38篇，最终得97篇一级文献。（3）数据收集：定义各维度与度量尺度（时间尺度、单选/多选开放尺度、封闭尺度），由两作者分三轮提取：先共同精读25篇样本并交叉合并、讨论澄清（引入"check together"等类目），随后第一作者提取其余论文并每周例会讨论，最后通过开放式卡片分类（open card sorting）统一开放尺度的词汇体系并将分类回溯应用于全部97篇，统计各维度频次、共现与主题聚类。此外以Wohlin等（2012）的评审协议控制效度威胁，并提供Zenodo公开复现包（数据集+分析脚本+分类体系）。
AI.result: （1）发表分布：文献覆盖2004–2025年5月，滚动两年窗口显示数量持续上升，2022–2023年达到峰值（2024–2025年5月回落主要因数据库索引不全）；会议论文71篇多于期刊26篇，主要发表于ICSE(13)、MSR(8)、ESEC/FSE(6)、SANER(6)及TSE(5)、EMSE(4)、TOSEM(3)、JSS(3)，投稿渠道分布广泛且集中于顶级会议期刊。（2）研究目标：归纳为四大主题下的8个类别——缺陷分析（含缺陷分析与定位40、缺陷分类/分派3）、缺陷修复识别（含安全补丁识别18、稳定补丁识别2）、自动程序修复7、安全开发实践6、及其他；缺陷识别与定位占主导，自动程序修复与安全开发实践等主题受关注明显不足。（3）软件工件：共识别11类，其中代码变更/diff（78）使用最多，其后为问题跟踪（30）、开发者度量（18）、漏洞信息（16），还有PR、开发者讨论、社区反馈、发布说明、代码注释、设计文档、提交元数据；最常见共现模式为{提交信息, 代码变更}，其次为{提交信息, 代码变更, 问题跟踪}，单独使用提交信息较少。（4）方法论：仓库挖掘（89）> NLP（82）> AI/ML（72）> 人工检查，社区反馈与受控实验较少，最常见组合为{仓库挖掘, NLP, AI/ML}。（5）干系人：开发者（81）> 研究者（48）> 维护者（19），维护者多出现在稳定性与安全导向的研究中。（6）关键发现：在缺陷分析中，提交信息提供语义信息显著提升即时缺陷预测准确率，缺失提交信息或代码变更均明显降低模型性能，信息量大、结构化的消息效果更好而短小噪声消息会损害预测；缺陷分派中其语言特征与缺陷报告高度吻合；自动修复中结构化消息帮助LLM生成更优补丁并链接自然语言意图与代码语义；缺陷修复识别与安全补丁识别中，含修复关键词、issue/CVE引用的清晰消息能显著区分修复性提交、提升模型准确率；但各类研究均报告提交信息常缺失必要细节、安全信息隐含于领域词汇中、难以完整表达修改意图。
AI.conclusion: 提交信息在纠正性维护中扮演重要角色：它承载关键语义信息，帮助开发者、维护者与研究者理解软件演化并改进代码库，同时是缺陷预测、自动修复与补丁识别等自动化任务的重要特征来源；但现有提交信息普遍信息不足、结构松散，无法充分传达代码变更意图。据此论文分别向开发者（遵循严格规则与词典、保留自然语言模式与技术术语、包含显式理由与上下文、采用commit-info/subject/body分节结构、明确安全引用CVE/bug ID而不隐藏漏洞性质）、维护者（制定显式指南与统一操作术语如Conventional Commits、提供范例文档、主动复核新手提交）与研究者（标准化模板与最佳实践、探索情感与情绪线索、审慎预处理以免误删VRSN/RLS等缩写、融合测试数据与issue信息、降低人工验证成本）提出改进建议。作者指出三个未来研究缺口：弥合纠正性维护既定目标与干系人实际需求之间的落差；深入研究遵循官方提交信息准则的收益与代价权衡、界定理想的VCS历史形态；通过访谈或问卷对干系人进行三角验证，以理解提交信息质量对纠正性维护的实际影响。本研究为该主题的首个二次研究，并公开提供可复现的数据与分类体系。

title: AdaExplore: Failure-Driven Adaptation and Diversity-Preserving Search for Efficient Kernel Generation
comment: Preliminary work. The implementation is available at https://github.com/StigLidu/AdaExplore
summary: Recent large language model (LLM) agents have shown promise in using execution feedback for test-time adaptation. However, robust self-improvement remains far from solved: most approaches still treat each problem instance independently, without accumulating reusable knowledge. This limitation is particularly pronounced in domain-specific languages such as Triton, which are underrepresented in LLM pretraining data. Their strict constraints and non-linear optimization landscape further make naive generation and local refinement unreliable. We propose AdaExplore, an agent framework that enables self-improvement via accumulated execution feedback for performance-critical kernel code generation through two complementary stages: failure-driven adaptation and diversity-preserving search, jointly improving correctness and optimization performance without additional fine-tuning or external knowledge. In the adaptation stage, the agent synthesizes tasks and converts recurring failures into a reusable memory of validity rules, helping subsequent generations remain within the feasible set. In the search stage, the agent organizes candidate kernels as a tree and alternates between small local refinements and larger structural regeneration, allowing it to explore the optimization landscape beyond local optima. Experiments on kernel runtime optimization benchmarks validate these gains: AdaExplore achieves 3.12x and 1.72x speedups on KernelBench Level-2 and Level-3, respectively, within 100 steps, and continues to improve with additional computation.

AI.tldr: AdaExplore 是一个面向 GPU 内核（Triton）运行时优化的 LLM Agent 框架，通过两个阶段实现"无微调的自进化"：Adapt 阶段从合成任务的执行失败中蒸馏出跨任务的"技能记忆"（可复用的有效性规则），提升生成内核的正确率；Explore 阶段把候选内核组织成树，用 UCT 风格节点选择 + 小步局部补丁/大步结构重生成两种动作交替搜索，避免陷入局部最优。在 KernelBench 上，100 步预算下 Level-2 达到 3.11× 加速、Level-3 达到 1.62×，且随算力增加持续改进而未饱和。
AI.motivation: LLM Agent 虽能利用执行反馈做测试时自适应，但大多把每个问题实例孤立处理、不积累可复用知识；Triton 等领域特定语言在预训练数据中稀缺，可行性边界陡峭（语法/访存/并行化的小错即编译或运行失败），且性能地景观高度非线性与组合性，需要协调的结构性改动而非局部微调。因此作者把内核运行时优化形式化为"带正确性硬约束的搜索问题"，并归纳出两大瓶颈：C1 可行探索（如何在狭窄可行集内探索）、C2 优化效率（如何在崎岖地景观中平衡全局探索与局部精修）。
AI.method:
整体分为 Adapt 与 Explore 两阶段。
Adapt（失败驱动适应）：以 PyTorch 算子文档为素材，用 Evol-Instruct 式变异重组合成 200 个训练任务（GPT-5 生成，执行报错样本丢弃）；让 Agent 为每个任务生成 Triton 内核并对照参考实现执行，将失败诊断由 LLM 归纳为简洁约束规则（如"不能在 Triton 内把 tl.float32 当函数调用"）；用 LLM 判别器做语义去重并统计频次，仅保留频次 O≥3 的条目作为跨任务技能记忆，并在线增量更新、注入后续生成。统计：1178 条原始经验→174 条去重→78 条保留（token 量 1655，与静态文档基线 1616 相当）。
Explore（多样性保持搜索）：候选内核构成搜索树而非单一链；节点扩展有 small step（基于 old_str/new_str 的局部补丁精修，先给出 review guidance）和 large step（以"超越池中最快内核"为目标的重构重生成）两种动作，large step 概率 p_large=0.2、root 强制 large；上下文用双记忆——working memory（路径上最近 C_recent=5 步的编辑与执行反馈）与代表内核池 K_pool（把路径按连续 small step 切成连通段，每段最多贡献一个代表，至多采样 C_pool=5 个），large step 清空 working memory、small step 清空 K_pool；节点选择用 UCT 规则并显式加入 expand 选项（Expand(s)=Q_expand(s)+c_expand·sqrt(ln N(s)/|C(s)|²)），c_explore=0.3，Level-2/3 的 c_expand 分别 0.3/0.15。执行正确性与运行时反馈更新路径上的访问计数与 Q 值。超参：Adapt 200 任务×25 候选，O=3；温度 T_LLM=1。
AI.result: KernelBench（NVIDIA A6000，1500MHz 固定频率，CUDA event 计时，10 次预热+100 次计时并对最快最慢各 5% 做对称截尾；速度比上限裁到 10×）：AdaExplore 在 50/100/200 步的 Level-2 加速分别为 2.63×/3.11×/3.27×，准确率 100%，100 步时 Fast@1.2=77%、Fast@2=44%；Level-3 在 50/100/200 步为 1.56×/1.62×/1.72×，Fast@2=16%/18%/22%。均优于 PS、PS w. SM、IR、IR w. SM、OpenEvolve w. SM、DR.Kernel 等多轮基线。技能记忆单独有效：GPT-5-mini 在 L2 上 Pass@1 从 22%→54%、Pass@25 从 76%→100%，优于规模相当的静态 Triton API 文档基线（34%/94%）；GPT-5 51%→67%、Qwen3-Coder-Next 7%→17%，在 TritonBench-T 上单次生成 54%→82%。跨 GPU 泛化：L40S/A100/GB200 上分别 2.13×/3.07×/2.98×（准确率 99%/100%/100%）。FlashInfer-Bench（B200）：RMSNorm 7.22× 于 PyTorch、1.75× 于专家 FlashInfer CUDA；GQA paged decode 18.17× 于 PyTorch 但慢于专家 6.5×；GEMM 仅达 cuBLAS 的 0.42×。消融：去掉技能记忆 2.63×→2.23×，去代表内核池→2.30×，去树搜索（链式）→2.45×，去 large step→2.60×，去 small step→2.35×（且准确率降至 99%）。案例分析显示 large step 代码相似度仅 19–20% 且带来跃升，small step 相似度 60–88% 带来渐进增益。成本估算：一次性 Adapt+合成约 $201，Level-2 100 步搜索约 $122；同等加速下总花费 $323 低于 IR w. SM 在 200 步的 $445。
AI.conclusion: 内核运行时优化需要同时解决"生成正确"和"搜索高性能"两个问题，二者机制互补而非冗余：跨任务技能记忆把反复出现的 DSL/语法/索引类失败压缩为紧凑可复用规则，显著提升正确性并隐性加速搜索；树结构的多样性保持搜索则在正确性达标后持续挖掘更优内核，摆脱单链局部最优。AdaExplore 无需额外微调或外部知识即可获得明显测试时扩展收益，且随预算增加未见饱和；但对 GEMM 等经厂商库数十年深度优化的工作负载仍难超越，且在 Blackwell 专属指令等硬件特化机制上能力有限，提示未来需引入额外知识与参考技能。作者还指出跨模型记忆迁移并非普适（GPT-5 受益大，DeepSeek-R1 几乎无变化）。

title: Machine individuality: Separating genuine idiosyncrasy from response bias in large language models
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into daily life, in roles ranging from high-stakes decision support to companionship, understanding their behavioral dispositions becomes critical. A growing literature uses psychometric inventories and cognitive paradigms to profile LLM dispositions. However, these approaches cannot determine whether behavioral differences reflect stable, stimulus-specific individuality or global response biases and stochastic noise. Here, we apply crossed random-effects models -- widely used in psychometrics to separate systematic effects -- to 74.9 million ratings provided by 10 open-weight LLMs for over 100,000 words across 14 psycholinguistic norms. On average, 16.9% of variance is attributable to stimulus-specific individuality, robustly exceeding a statistical null model. Cross-norm prediction analyses reveal this individuality as a coherent fingerprint, unique to each model. These results identify individual differences among LLMs that cannot be attributed to response biases or stochastic noise. We term these differences machine individuality.

AI.tldr: 本文用交叉随机效应模型（crossed random-effects LMM）把 LLM 在心理语言学规范上的评分行为分解为共享特质、系统性偏差、刺激特异性个体差异与残差噪声，发现平均 16.9% 的方差来自"模型×词"交互（即真实的、特异性的个体差异），远高于参数化零模型（<0.033%，p<0.01）；且这些差异跨规范高度连贯、构成每个模型独有的"指纹"。作者称之为"机器个体性"（machine individuality）。
AI.motivation: 现有文献用心理测量量表、认知范式和分类器为 LLM 描绘"人格"，但存在根本性缺陷：(1) 测得的人格分数随提示模板、选项顺序、量表类型剧烈波动；(2) 判别式分类器虽能以 97% 准确率区分模型来源，但其信号主要来自表层文体特征（措辞习惯、格式惯例），等同于"反应风格"；(3) 这些方法混淆了稳定的刺激特异性特质与全局方向性反应偏差（如默许作答、极端作答）以及随机噪声。心理学早已指出个体性存在于"人×情境"交互之中，因此需要一种能够把共享共识、系统偏差与情境特异反应分离的量化框架，并回答：LLM 是否存在可与偏差和噪声分离的稳定行为个体性？
AI.method: 以心理语言学词评定作为行为测量范式：10 个开放权重 LLM（14B–235B，涵盖稠密 Transformer、MoE、混合 Mamba-2 等架构，7 家提供方），对 psychNorms 元数据库的 107,083 个线索词、14 个规范（效价、唤醒、具体性、5 个感官规范、2 个习得年龄、道德、性别联想、幽默、社会性）作零样本数值评分；随机采样 T=1.0、每词 5 次重复（另加 T=0 确定性解码对照），经多阶段重试与解析清洗后获得约 7490 万条观测（每规范约 540 万条）。对每个规范单独拟合交叉随机效应线性混合模型 y_ijk = μ + τ_i + β_j + ι_ij + ε_ijk，将方差分解为共享 Trait、系统性 Bias、模型×词 Idiosyncrasy 与 Residual；用 N=100 的参数化 bootstrap（生成无交互项的合成数据再重拟合）检验交互方差是否超过结构性伪影；用 Ridge 回归（5 折交叉验证）以各模型的 BLUP 做留一规范的跨范预测，计算 Specificity Ratio（模型内 R²/跨模型平均 R²）；用 Pearson r（Fisher-z 聚合）评估与人类规范的一致性并比较随机聚合与确定性解码。
AI.result: 1) 方差分解：共享 Trait 占 32.1%（语义景观存在广泛跨模型共识）；Idiosyncrasy 平均占 16.9%，范围 4.8%（效价）至 34.0%（性别联想），14 个规范全部显著超过零模型上限（<0.033%，p<0.01），且大于 Bias。2) 跨范连贯性：所有模型 Specificity Ratio 均 >1（1.74–3.43），高于直接用原始评分的比率（1.16–1.49），说明模型在某维度上的偏离主要由其自身在其他维度的偏离预测，形成模型特异语义指纹。3) 结构差异：性别联想与唤醒变异最大（34.0%、22.6%），味觉最小（9.7%）；道德的 Bias 分量显著；效价、社会性、具体性、习得年龄由 Trait 主导。4) 人类对齐：模型与人类规范仅中等相关（r̄ = 0.48–0.67），提示 LLM 语义表征部分"自成一体"（sui generis）而非人类判断的噪声近似。5) 随机聚合一致优于确定性解码（Δr̄ = 0.032；10/10 模型、14/14 规范），形成"可复现性—对齐度"权衡。
AI.conclusion: LLM 存在真实、可测量的"机器个体性"：在 14 个心理语言学规范上，刺激特异性偏离在剔除共享语义共识与系统性方向偏差后仍解释 4.8–34.0% 的方差，且跨维度内部连贯、模型间独特。这一结果要求在评估 LLM 行为倾向时，必须像人格心理学区分实质特质与反应风格那样，分离刺激特异性个体性与方向性偏差；聚合式人格分数因混合了两者而在解释上根本含糊。作者强调该分解框架具有普适适用性（适用于任何多个模型对同一刺激集合作答的场景），并留下开放问题：这些个体性是否在情境化提示下仍持续、是否能预测下游行为差异；后者才是证明机器个体性不仅可测而且重要的关键。

title: Trust, but Verify: ByzTwin-Range, a Digital Twin Cyber-Range for Byzantine Faults
summary: Critical infrastructures increasingly rely on interconnected and software-driven Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS), exposing operational processes to both accidental failures and sophisticated adversarial behavior. While Byzantine Fault Tolerant (BFT) protocols offer robustness against arbitrary faults, evaluating their behavior under realistic cyber-physical conditions remains challenging: traditional cyber ranges lack timing fidelity, and testing in production environments is unsafe. This paper introduces ByzTwin-Range, a dual-layer architecture that integrates a production-grade BFT deployment with a Digital Twin (DT) to enable controlled experimentation, stress testing, and Byzantine fault injection using live operational data. The DT mirrors real system state, executes "What-if" analyses through co-simulation and emulation, and identifies synchrony vulnerabilities, i.e., misconfigured timeouts, timing-sensitive false suspicions, and adversarial delay exploits, configuration weaknesses, and adversarial behaviors that may undermine BFT guarantees. Insights from the twin are fed back into the operational deployment through a secure advisory channel, supporting continuous validation and adaptive hardening. The proposed design leverages industry-standard technologies (Open Platform Communications Unified Architecture, Time-Sensitive Networking, Functional Mock-up Unit/High-Level Architecture, QUIC/mutual TLS) to maximize feasibility and compatibility with existing industrial workflows. ByzTwin-Range establishes a practical foundation for next-generation, BFT-aware cyber ranges and paves the way for more resilient CPSs through continuous testing, differential-privacy-enabled analytics, and future proof-of-concept implementations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ByzTwin-Range：一种"生产级拜占庭容错（BFT）部署 + 数字孪生（Digital Twin）"的双层架构，把真实工业控制系统（OT平面）的实时遥测持续镜像到隔离的运维孪生平面（OTw），在孪生环境中开展"What-if"分析、压力测试与拜占庭故障注入，从而在不影响生产的前提下暴露BFT协议的超时误配、视图切换相关的假怀疑（false suspicion）、对抗性延迟攻击、配置弱点等同步性（synchrony）脆弱区，并将孪生得出的建议通过只读的非对称安全咨询通道回灌到真实系统，形成持续验证与自适应加固的闭环。论文以架构与方法论为主，尚未给出概念验证实现。
AI.motivation: 关键基础设施正日益依赖互联、软件驱动的信息物理系统（CPS），攻击面随之扩大。虽然 BFT 协议可容忍任意（含恶意）故障，但其评测面临两难：传统网络靶场（cyber range）依赖合成数据集，缺乏时序保真度与工业运行语义；直接在被控生产系统上做故障注入则不安全且不可接受。此外，现有故障注入实践把测试视为部署前的一次性活动，基于静态测试床，无法覆盖随负载漂移、对手演化而出现的时序窗口与配置漂移。作者因此希望引入数字孪生作为持续运行的"活靶场"，在真实时序与真实数据条件下反复验证 BFT 的安全性与活性保证，把孪生从一次性诊断工具转变为自加固机制。
AI.method: 方法为提出 ByzTwin-Range 双层架构与配套方法论，主要组件包括：(1) OT 平面——真实 CPS，含执行本地安全逻辑与看门狗失效安全回退的 PLC、看门狗，以及部署 BFT 监督层（3f+1 副本，最多 f 个拜占庭副本），副本间以 VLAN/TSN 互连，遥测经 OPC UA Pub/Sub over UDP 发出，底层为 TSN/L2 确定性网络；(2) Broker 与 Time Gateway——提供时间对齐（真实/逻辑/仿真时间转换、确定性事件排序与延迟标注）、主题化安全中介（协议归一化：OPC UA PubSub→MQTT/Kafka/HLA/FMU；mTLS over QUIC、RBAC、消息签名）以及跨层可追溯日志与可复现回放；(3) OTw 平面——隔离的孪生执行环境，含流式存储（append-only 时序日志）、特征库（版本化 ML 特征）、联邦学习（FL）与差分隐私（DP）分析、基于 FMU/HLA 的 What-if 协同仿真与仿真联邦、BFT 故障注入引擎（可注入 equivocation、状态报告不一致、选择性丢包、针对性副本扰动）、K8s/K3s 编排的仿真工作负载；(4) 非对称建议通道——OTw 仅向 BFT Manager 发出只读意图，由其独占执行决策权，防止被篡改的孪生直接影响生产；(5) Historian/CMDB 知识库沉淀已验证配置与剧本。威胁模型假设：攻击者可攻陷有界副本子集并操纵网络时序但不能完全控制环境；系统处于部分同步（有限但可变/被对抗扰动的延迟）；OT 平面为严格实时（TSN），OTw 与层间通信为部分同步；孪生内的流存储、时间网关、编排器按 CFT 组件对待（可崩溃重启但非拜占庭）；假设 PLC 与看门狗失效安全，否则需引入人在回路回退并将 BFT 层降级为咨询角色；不假设完全对抗性的物理过程。
AI.result: 论文给出了完整的架构拓扑、组件职责划分、威胁模型与假设，以及四条核心贡献：双层 BFT+DT 架构、基于孪生实时状态的受控拜占庭故障注入模型、自动识别 BFT 脆弱区与同步性压力条件的方法、以及将实际 BFT 部署与下一代靶场实验桥接的流程方法学。作者明确说明贡献属架构与方法论性质，概念验证（POC）实现被列为紧随其后的未来工作，故论文本身未提供实测性能数据或对比基线。同时论文也指出若干开放挑战：BFT 最坏时延与工业控制确定性时序难以对齐（尤其视图切换与对抗网络下）、OT 与孪生间状态一致性漂移、FMU/HLA 高保真协同仿真的算力与编排开销、以及故障注入需扩展到协调型/跨层/协议感知的对抗行为并验证其物理影响。
AI.conclusion: ByzTwin-Range 建立了面向 BFT 感知的下一代网络靶场的实践基础：它以工业标准技术（OPC UA、TSN、FMU/HLA、Kubernetes、QUIC/mTLS）保证可行性与既有工业工作流兼容性，把"测试"重构为由实时数据驱动的持续运维闭环，通过数字孪生中的受控对抗实验提前暴露时序窗口、相关故障与配置弱点，再经只读安全通道反馈为配置调优与自适应加固建议，从而提升关键 CPS 的韧性。下一步是构建并评测概念验证系统，重点验证实时性能条件下的可行性与收益。

title: SkillGraph: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Collaboration with Multimodal Graph Topology
summary: Scaling vision-language models into Visual Multiagent Systems (VMAS) is hindered by two coupled issues. First, communication topologies are fixed before inference, leaving them blind to visual content and query context; second, agent reasoning abilities remain static during deployment. These issues reinforce each other: a rigid topology fails to leverage richer agent expertise, while static agents lack incentives to specialize for a given query. We address this with SkillGraph, a joint framework that evolves both agent expertise and communication topology. Within this framework, a Multimodal Graph Transformer (MMGT) encodes visual tokens, instruction semantics and active skill embeddings to predict a query-conditioned collaboration graph, replacing hand-crafted routing with dynamic, content-aware information flow. Complementing this, a Skill Designer distills and refines reasoning heuristics from failure cases, constructing a self-evolving multimodal Skill Bank. Crucially, updated skill embeddings are fed back into the MMGT, enabling the topology to adapt alongside capability growth. Experiments show that SkillGraph achieves consistent improvements across four benchmarks, five common MAS structures and four base models. Code is available at https://github.com/niez233/skillgraph.

AI.tldr: SkillGraph 是一个面向视觉多智能体系统(VMAS)的自演化框架，通过 Multimodal Graph Transformer (MMGT) 在推理时依据图像 patch、问题语义与各智能体当前激活技能嵌入预测查询条件化的有向通信图，同时用 Skill Designer 从失败案例中修订/新建技能形成自演化 Skill Bank，且更新后的技能嵌入回流到 MMGT 形成闭环共演化。在 4 个基准(MMBench/MathVista/RealWorldQA/InfoVQA)、5 种 MAS 拓扑(Linear/Layered/Centralized/Random/Complete)、4 种 VLM 主干(Qwen3-VL-8B、LLaVA-OneVision-Qwen2-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL3-8B)及 2B–38B 多尺度模型上均取得一致提升(如 Qwen3-VL-8B Complete 结构平均分 81.7→82.9，Thinking 下 MathVista 提升最高约 3.2 分)。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉多智能体系统(VMAS)存在"结构刚性"与"认知刚性"两大耦合缺陷：(1) 通信拓扑在推理前即被固定，无法感知查询的视觉内容与语义——无论任务需要细粒度 OCR、复杂空间推理还是抽象逻辑演绎，信息都沿同一不变通路流动；(2) 智能体的推理能力被冻结在手写提示中，测试期出现持续性多模态"盲区"时缺乏自主修正或生成新推理启发式的机制。作者认为根源在于任务内容、智能体技能能力与通信拓扑三者的系统性解耦：最优协作图应是"查询多模态语义 × 当前激活技能"的动态函数，而非静态模板。已有可学习拓扑方法(GPTSwarm、G-Designer、MASS)仅基于纯文本构建图，视觉内容完全被排除在拓扑预测环路之外；已有技能库工作(记忆摘要、代码技能、RL 技能注入)虽更新技能，却不向协作结构回传任何信号，视觉特征也不参与技能检索与演化。作者进一步强调二者互为因果：僵化拓扑无法利用更丰富的专长，静态智能体也缺乏针对特定查询做专精化的动力，形成恶性循环。
AI.method: 框架分为 Construct–Design–Evolve 三阶段并闭环耦合。Construct：为 N 个智能体配备从分层 Skill Bank 语义检索得到的技能 s=(c_trig 触发条件, d_strat 分步策略, π=n_succ/n_use 滚动准确率, F 有界失败缓冲, ν 版本号)；用轻量句编码器对 (c_trig‖d_strat) 编码得节点特征 X_agent∈R^{N×D}，技能被检索或演化时即时重算并回灌拓扑预测器，无需额外参数更新。Design：MMGT 为五阶段编码器——(1) 多模态查询编码器用冻结 CLIP 提取 P 个图像 patch token，与句编码器得到的问题嵌入经 cross-attention 融合并加文本残差捷径(防止问题语义被图像特征淹没)得全局上下文 v；(2) per-agent 选择性图像注意力，把技能嵌入投影后经 sigmoid 门控 g_i 与 v 融合为个体化图像查询 q̃_i，各智能体独立关注与自身技能相关的图像区域；(3) 堆叠 L 层 Graph Transformer Layer 与 Global Relay Node Layer，GTL 内全对全自注意力加角色先验偏置 B(role 兼容为 0，其余 -10^4，即仅"抑制"而非硬屏蔽，允许证据充分时跨角色通信)；GRNL 实现全局节点 v 与智能体集合 H 的双向 cross-attention 交互；(4) 方向感知双线性边打分器 e_ij=h_i^T W_edge h_j+b(W_edge 非对称，天然建模有向非对称信息流)，logit 归一化到 [-1,1] 以防饱和并稳定策略梯度；(5) 在预定义候选边集 E_cand 内对每条有向边独立做 Bernoulli 采样 σ(ẽ_ij)，并用 BFS 做环检测强制 DAG，智能体按拓扑序执行。Evolve：失败时由 LLM 生成简洁诊断教训 l，连同 (q, I, â, a*, l) 存入对应技能的失败缓冲 F(s)；每 K 步由元智能体 Skill Designer 筛出 |F(s)|≥τ_f 的"难技能"，据失败模式执行 Modify(就地修订 c_trig/d_strat，ν+1，清空 F 但保留累计 π)或 Create(合成新技能 s_new 入库，π 从 0 递增更新)两种动作。共演化双向耦合：S→MMGT(技能变动即失效并重建嵌入缓存 M，节点特征与 h_i^(0) 随之变化，注意力模式、个体图像查询与角色偏置隐式更新，无需梯度步)；MMGT→S(拓扑决定哪些技能被何种视觉子任务激发，进而决定失败记录归属与演化速度)。训练：把离散图采样视为随机策略，最大化 E_θ[u(G_com(Q))]，u 为 0/1 正确性效用，用 REINFORCE 式梯度 -(1/B)Σ r_b ∇_θ log P(G_com^(b))，其中 log P 为各边伯努利对数似然之和，r_b 为 detach 的奖励标量；每 K 步异步执行技能演化并失效嵌入缓存。
AI.result: 主实验(Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct/Thinking)：对 Linear/Layered/Centralized/Random/Complete 五种结构均有一致提升，例如 Complete 结构 Instruct 平均分 81.7→82.9(+1.2)，MMBench 84.9→86.8、MathVista 81.8→83.2、RealWorldQA 75.2→76.4；Thinking 下提升更大(如 Complete: MMBench 84.2→87.4(+3.2)、MathVista 83.8→85.6、RealWorldQA 75.4→78.1(+2.7))。MathVista 与 RealWorldQA 增益最显著(组合推理、空间与物理推理)，InfoVQA 增益较小(受文档感知/文本定位瓶颈限制，可优化空间小)。跨主干泛化：LLaVA-OV-Qwen2-7B 平均 73.2→74.6、Qwen2.5-VL-7B 77.4→78.7、InternVL3-8B 77.4→79.4，均稳定提升。消融：Skill Evolution 与 MMGT 单独启用均有正贡献，二者组合总体最优(存在个别数据集上单模块更优的情况)，二者互补——前者改善"智能体能调用什么能力"，后者改善"这些能力如何协调"。规模效应：2B→38B 均获益但绝对增益随规模递减(Qwen3-VL-4B +2.1，32B +0.8；InternVL3-2B +3.0，38B +0.9)，体现强单智能体的边际递减效应。迭代曲线：性能随迭代单调上升，5→10 增益最明显，10→15 变缓，15 后基本饱和；Thinking 模式一致优于 Instruct。技能库演化统计：Create+Modify 动作数随迭代单调下降(库收敛而非无界膨胀)，MathVista 技能库规模最大(几何/代数/图表等子任务多样)，InfoVQA 最早饱和。案例研究展示某常识视觉推理技能从"依赖刻板常识先验"经 v2 到 v5–v7 演进为"枚举视觉线索→生成 2–3 个假设→逐一对照证据→宁可保守作答"的证据检验协议，累计准确率 π 从 0.51→0.58→0.67。
AI.conclusion: SkillGraph 通过 MMGT 的查询条件化多模态图设计与自演化 Skill Bank 两条机制的闭环耦合，同时缓解 VMAS 的结构刚性与认知刚性：技能演化无需梯度更新即可重塑拓扑预测流形，拓扑又反过来决定技能激发与失败归因，从而实现结构与知识的相互强化。实验覆盖多基准、多拓扑结构、多主干、多模型尺度，验证了一致优于固定拓扑与静态技能基线，且在空间推理与数学组合推理任务上收益最大；随骨干规模增大增益递减但始终为正。作者将自身定位为首个在多模态微调中实现图结构与技能知识双向共演化的机制，为"多模态感知—动态协作—终身技能学习"三者桥接提供了可扩展的集体智能基础。局限与可延伸处在于：增益随模型规模递减、InfoVQA 类文档感知任务空间有限、跨模态可学习拓扑的对比方法多为纯文本(GPTSwarm/G-Designer 等)未纳入同口径视觉基线，且 Skill Designer 依赖 LLM 元智能体带来的推理成本与可审计性问题(论文亦提及技能迭代需可审计验证)。

title: FairLogue: Evaluating Intersectional Fairness across Clinical Machine Learning Use Cases using the All of Us Research Program
summary: Intersectional biases in healthcare data can produce compound disparities in clinical machine learning models, yet most fairness evaluations assess demographic attributes independently. FairLogue, a toolkit for intersectional fairness auditing, was applied across multiple clinical prediction tasks to evaluate disparities across combined demographic groups. Using the All of Us dataset, two published models were selected for replication and evaluation: (A) prediction of selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor associated bleeding events and (B) two-year stroke risk in patients with atrial fibrillation. Observational fairness metrics were computed across race, gender, and intersectional subgroups, followed by counterfactual analysis to evaluate whether disparities were attributable to group membership. Intersectional evaluation revealed larger disparities than single-axis analyses; however, counterfactual diagnostics indicated that most observed disparities were comparable to those expected under randomized group membership. These results highlight the importance of intersectional fairness auditing and demonstrate how FairLogue provides deeper insight into bias in clinical machine learning systems.

AI.tldr: 本文将FairLogue（交叉性公平审计工具包）应用于临床预测任务，在All of Us数据集上复现并评估两个已发表模型（SSRI相关出血事件预测、房颤患者两年卒中风险预测），计算跨种族、性别及其交叉子群的公平性指标并辅以反事实分析。结果显示：交叉子群中的不平等幅度大于单轴评估，但反事实诊断表明多数观测差异与随机分配群体身份下预期的差异水平相当，即这些差异未必直接源于群体成员身份。
AI.motivation: 医疗健康数据中的交叉性偏差（intersectional bias）会在临床机器学习模型中产生复合性不平等（例如种族与性别的联合子群可能承受叠加的不利影响），而现有公平性评估实践大多仅对各人口学属性进行独立、逐轴的分析，遗漏了交叉子群层面的差异，评估结论可能因此过于乐观；同时单纯的观测公平性指标无法区分差异究竟来自模型/群体的直接区别对待，还是来自数据与标签分布本身的结构性差异，因而需要引入反事实诊断作为归因手段。
AI.method: 在All of Us数据集上选择两个已发表的临床预测模型进行复现与再评估：(A) 选择性5-羟色胺再摄取抑制剂（SSRI）相关出血事件预测模型；(B) 房颤患者两年卒中风险预测模型。评估流程包括两步：(1) 观测公平性评估——针对种族、性别以及两者的交叉子群分别计算公平性指标，比较单轴分析与交叉分析所得差异幅度；(2) 反事实分析（counterfactual analysis）——在保持个体其他特征不变的前提下改变群体成员身份标签，检验观测到的子群差异是否可归因于群体身份本身，并与随机群体分配情形下预期的指标差异水平进行对照。
AI.result: 交叉子群评估揭示出的差异幅度大于仅基于单一人口学属性的评估，说明单轴分析低估了某些复合子群的潜在不平等。然而反事实诊断显示，大多数被观测到的差异与在随机群体成员身份条件下所预期的差异水平相当（即在给定协变量与标签结构下，随机化群体标签同样会产生同等量级的公平性指标偏移），提示这些差异主要由数据的内在结构/标签分布与样本构成驱动，而非模型对特定群体身份的直接歧视性处理。
AI.conclusion: 研究凸显了交叉性公平性审计在临床机器学习中的重要性，并展示FairLogue如何提供超越传统单轴公平性评估的更深层偏倚洞见：它既能暴露被单轴分析掩盖的复合性不平等，也能通过反事实诊断帮助区分「算法引入的差别对待」与「数据/结局层面固有的群体差异」。因此在解释公平性指标时必须结合反事实对照，否则容易将统计上显著的群体差异误读为模型歧视；该方法学为临床ML模型部署前的公平性问责提供了可复用的审计范式。

title: On the Robustness of LLM-Based Dense Retrievers: A Systematic Analysis of Generalizability and Stability
summary: Decoder-only large language models (LLMs) are increasingly replacing BERT-style architectures as the backbone for dense retrieval, achieving substantial performance gains and broad adoption. However, the robustness of these LLM-based retrievers remains underexplored. In this paper, we present the first systematic study of the robustness of state-of-the-art open-source LLM-based dense retrievers from two complementary perspectives: generalizability and stability. For generalizability, we evaluate retrieval effectiveness across four benchmarks spanning 30 datasets, using linear mixed-effects models to estimate marginal mean performance and disentangle intrinsic model capability from dataset heterogeneity. Our analysis reveals that while instruction-tuned models generally excel, those optimized for complex reasoning often suffer a ``specialization tax,'' exhibiting limited generalizability in broader contexts. For stability, we assess model resilience against both unintentional query variations~(e.g., paraphrasing, typos) and malicious adversarial attacks~(e.g., corpus poisoning). We find that LLM-based retrievers show improved robustness against typos and corpus poisoning compared to encoder-only baselines, yet remain vulnerable to semantic perturbations like synonymizing. Further analysis shows that embedding geometry (e.g., angular uniformity) provides predictive signals for lexical stability and suggests that scaling model size generally improves robustness. These findings inform future robustness-aware retriever design and principled benchmarking. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/liyongkang123/Robust_LLM_Retriever_Eval.

AI.tldr: 本文对 SOTA 开源 decoder-only LLM 稠密检索器（Qwen3、Linq、GTE、ReasonIR、DIVER、ReasonEmbed 等）做了首个系统性鲁棒性研究，从"泛化性（generalizability）"与"稳定性（stability）"两个维度展开：在 30 个数据集（MS MARCO / BEIR / BRIGHT / BrowseComp-Plus）上用线性混合效应模型（LMM）估计边际均值（EMM）以剥离数据集异质性，并用 5 类查询扰动与语料投毒攻击度量性能退化。结论：指令增强模型泛化性最佳、推理型模型存在"专业化税"；LLM 检索器对拼写错误与白盒投毒明显更鲁棒，但同义词替换仍是普遍弱点；嵌入角度均匀性是最清晰的跨模型鲁棒性诊断信号，但直接正则化它并不能提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 稠密检索的骨干正快速从 BERT 类编码器转向 decoder-only LLM（RepLLaMA、LLM2Vec 到 Qwen3-Embedding、DIVER），并在 BEIR/BRIGHT 等榜单上取得领先。然而现有鲁棒性研究存在三重缺口：(1) 泛化性研究多停留在 benchmark 级迁移，缺少任务类型/查询意图/语料来源等因子级的细粒度分析，且直接宏平均因数据集规模与难度差异而具误导性；(2) 稳定性研究通常将查询侧扰动与文档侧对抗攻击割裂开来，且多以 encoder-only 模型为对象；(3) 针对当代 LLM 检索器的系统比较与"哪些模型内在属性可预测鲁棒性"的分析几乎空白。作者因此需要一个兼顾统计严谨性（剥离数据集混淆）与威胁模型完整性（查询侧+文档侧）的统一框架。
AI.method: 三个研究问题驱动。RQ1 泛化性：9 个检索器（BM25、Contriever、BGE-M3 + 6 个 LLM 检索器）× 30 数据集 × 11 种任务类型/8 种查询类型（用 Bolotova 等的 nf-cats 分类器自动标注）/5 种语料来源类型；因评测不平衡且查询嵌套于数据集，采用线性混合效应模型 y=固定效应(模型、因子、交互)+数据集随机截距+查询随机截距+残差，输出估计边际均值（EMM），以 Type III F 检验（Satterthwaite 近似）判定显著性。RQ2 稳定性：查询侧采用 Penha 等的 5 类扰动（misspelling 用 Zhuang & Zuccon 更完备的字符级操作、reordering、synonymizing 用 counter-fitted GloVe/WordNet、paraphrasing 用回译或 T5、naturalizing 去停用词），在 NQ、MS MARCO Dev、HotpotQA、FiQA 上按相对性能下降率衡量，5 个随机种子；文档侧按 Zhong 等与 Li 等的设置做语料投毒，白盒用 HotFlip+K-means 聚类生成 50 token 对抗文档（|A|=10/50），度量 ASR@20，并额外做无访问的直接迁移黑盒攻击。RQ3 预测因子：角向均匀性（平均成对余弦相似度）与方差均匀性（IsoScore）与鲁棒性指标的 Pearson 相关（各采样 10 万对/10 万条），Qwen3 家族 0.6B/4B/8B 的族内规模缩放分析，以及用幂迭代估计各层主投影矩阵的平均谱范数；另在 MS MARCO 上用 LoRA 微调 Qwen3-0.6B 做角向均匀性正则化与双向注意力转换两项干预实验。
AI.result: RQ1：所有 Model×Factor 交互均极显著（F=166–469, p<.001），说明模型间差距随条件剧烈变化。指令增强模型（Qwen3/Linq/GTE）三因子平均 EMM 最高（任务 47.9–49.1，查询 46.5–47.1，语料 46.0–48.2）；推理型模型在 BRIGHT 12 个数据集中的 9 个最佳（如 ReasonEmbed 在 Theorem Retrieval 32.9、StackExchange 43.3），但出现"专业化税"——ReasonEmbed 在 Quora 仅 48.5、INSTRUCTION/EXPERIENCE 查询 EMM 近零（0.2/0.8）、Online Community 仅 4.5，整体查询型 EMM 仅 17.4。语料来源主效应不显著（p=.054）但与模型交互最强，说明语料来源的作用依模型而定；代码/定理检索对所有模型都难（<30）。RQ2：misspelling 上 LLM 指令增强模型明显更稳（MS MARCO 6–12% vs Contriever 42%、BGE-M3 17%），推理型模型无此优势（DIVER/ReasonEmbed ~27%）；synonymizing 是跨家族一致难点（22–27%），paraphrasing 更依赖数据集，短查询（MS MARCO 6.0 词、FiQA 10.8 词）受损最大而 HotpotQA（17.6 词）仅约 3%；reordering 暴露可能的架构效应（Contriever ~3%，GTE 例外地稳健），naturalizing 中 BGE-M3 最脆弱。白盒投毒下 GTE 达 0% ASR 全数据集全预算，ReasonIR 次之（<4%），Qwen3 较强但 HotpotQA 达 11.0，Linq 在 HotpotQA 达 43.8，Contriever 极脆弱（89–99.5，与点积 L2 膨胀有关），DIVER/ReasonEmbed 中等脆弱；直接迁移黑盒攻击在所有模型对与数据集上 ASR@20 均 <1%。RQ3：角向均匀性是最清晰信号（NQ：misspelling r=0.92、synonymizing r=0.85；MS MARCO：misspelling 0.91、reordering 0.92、synonymizing 0.97、投毒 0.91，均 p<0.01），主要关联词法/表层扰动而非语义稳定性；IsoScore 趋势零散且不显著；Qwen3 规模增大通常降低下降率（NQ misspelling 17.4%→10.1%，HotpotQA 投毒 25.1%→11.0%）但非单调；平均谱范数无显著相关。干预实验显示角向均匀性正则化虽把 FiQA 平均余弦相似度从 0.801 降到 0.139 且 nDCG 不变（35.5），但未带来鲁棒性提升；双向注意力转换亦无一致增益。
AI.conclusion: LLM 稠密检索的鲁棒性是多维属性，无法由单一架构、规模或几何统计量推断。评测应至少覆盖一个字符级扰动、一个语义改写与一个文档侧攻击并分扰动类型报告；模型选型应绑定目标风险画像——跨任务/查询/语料的广泛迁移首选 GTE 与 Qwen3，担忧白盒投毒时首选 GTE 与 ReasonIR；GTE 作为最强经验参照点，但其鲁棒性来源（训练数据、目标、优化选择未公开）仍是开放问题；角向均匀性应作为事后诊断信号而非独立训练目标，应优先开发面向查询改写不变性的训练目标（如原句—释义一致性损失）；需补做基于代理模型的黑盒攻击、训练时后门攻击、非英语检索与多向量/稀疏神经检索的鲁棒性分析，并警惕白盒与直接迁移风险的非对称性。

title: SCATR: Simple Calibrated Test-Time Ranking
summary: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves large language models (LLMs) by allocating additional compute at inference time. In practice, TTS is often achieved through parallel scaling: generating multiple candidate responses and selecting the best via a Best-of-N (BoN) strategy. Its effectiveness therefore hinges on the scoring function. Learned scorers such as process reward models (PRMs) can be strong, but they are expensive to train and run. Lightweight confidence heuristics based on token log-probabilities are much cheaper, yet we find that they often perform substantially worse. To improve on lightweight confidence heuristics without incurring the full cost of stronger learned scorers, we introduce SCATR, a simple and efficient BoN ranking method that learns a lightweight scorer from a small calibration set using hidden representations from the base model. Across coding and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, SCATR improves over prior confidence-based baselines by up to 9%. Relative to LoRA fine-tuning on the same calibration data, it achieves comparable accuracy with up to 8000x fewer trainable parameters and much lower compute, reducing training and inference latency by up to 150x and 1000x, respectively. SCATR is also competitive with strong PRM baselines, and in several settings improves accuracy by up to 7.8% on math and 4.2% on coding while enabling up to 1000x faster inference. Overall, SCATR offers a strong accuracy-efficiency trade-off for scalable test-time selection.

AI.tldr: SCaTR（Simple Calibrated Test-Time Ranking）是一种面向并行测试时扩展（parallel TTS）的轻量级 Best-of-N 排序方法：它不依赖 token 对数概率等置信度启发式，而是用基座模型**倒数第二层、最后一个非填充 token 的隐藏表示**作为质量信号，在一个小规模「校准集」（模型自生成 rollout + 客观正确性标签，通常仅数百题）上训练一个浅层 MLP 打分器，从而为特定模型/领域做校准。实验覆盖 OLMo-2、Qwen3、GPT-OSS 三大模型族（1.7B–30B），在 HumanEval/KodCode 与 AIME24/AIME25/MATH-500 上，相比最强置信度基线最高提升约 9%（数学 9.1%、代码 6.1%）；与强 PRM（ReasonFlux-1.5B）相比在多个设置下精度更高（数学最高 +7.8%、代码最高 +4.2%），同时推理最快约 1000×；与对同数据做 LoRA 微调的基线相比精度相当，但可训练参数少至多 8000×，训练/推理延迟最多降低 150×/1000×。消融显示：倒数第二层是稳健默认选择（各深层性能接近但方差更低）；校准集增大可提升精度并降方差（KodCode 上已饱和）；更复杂的打分架构（多层集成、Transformer 编码器、任务特定 token）并无一致增益，说明「简单 MLP + 单层表示」已是很强的操作点。
AI.motivation: 测试时扩展（TTS）通过在推理期分配额外算力提升 LLM 能力，其中并行扩展（独立采样 N 个候选 + Best-of-N 选择）因可并行而最具扩展性，其效果高度依赖打分函数 f(·)。现有方案存在两难：过程奖励模型（PRM）等学习型打分器能力强但训练与推理代价高昂；而基于 token 对数概率的轻量置信度启发式（平均/尾部/低分组置信度、top-k 中位数、方差、前二概率差、Shannon 熵等）虽然便宜，却因模型对错误答案过度自信、对正确答案信心不足而校准极差，在开放式任务（如代码生成，候选之间不存在唯一标准答案、多数投票失效）上几乎退化为随机选择。此外，N 增大带来收益递减，也提示需要更好的选择信号。作者的动机是：真正有判别力的信号可能不在输出概率里，而在模型的内部表示（隐藏状态）中——隐藏状态已被证明能支撑幻觉检测等下游任务。据此需要一种「比置信度启发式强、又不付学习型大打分器全额代价」的选择方法。
AI.method:
**SCaTR 框架（两阶段）**：

1. **校准阶段**：对 m 个任务 prompt x_i，用目标模型 M 生成 N 条 rollout y_ij；用领域专属评估器 E 给出二值标签 r_ij（代码：是否通过全部测试用例；数学：最终答案是否正确）；在生成过程中顺带抽取**倒数第二层、最后一个非填充 token** 的隐藏表示 e_ij，构成校准集 D_cal={(e_ij, r_ij)}。训练一个模型专属的浅层 MLP 打分器 f_θ: R^d→[0,1]，带 dropout、2–3 个隐藏层（隐藏维度从 {[512,256],[512,256,128],[1024,512],[1024,512,256]} 中选）、ReLU、单个标量 logit 输出，用带类别平衡权重 w=n_neg/n_pos 的加权交叉熵；按 problem ID 层面 75/25 划分防泄漏，Adam + 梯度裁剪(1.0) + ReduceLROnPlateau(0.5, patience 3) + 早停(patience 10, ≤100 epochs)，100 组随机搜索超参，取验证损失最低配置，3 随机种子 × 3 套校准集共 9 次运行取均值±标准差。

2. **推理/评估阶段**：新 prompt 并行生成 N 条候选，利用生成时顺带抽取的同一隐藏表示打分（无额外抽取开销）；代码等自由生成任务取 argmax s_j（Best-of-N）；数学等唯一答案任务额外用**加权多数投票** S(a)=Σ_j s_j·1{y_j=a}。

**基线**：随机选择、数学多数投票、置信度类 C_avg / C_bottom-10% / C_least / C_tail（top-k=10、group=1024、tail=2048）、ReasonFlux-1.5B/7B PRM、以及在同一校准数据上对基座模型做 LoRA 微调的正确性预测器（用最后 k=16,384 token（GPT-OSS 为 4,096）做 yes/no 分类）。所有主实验均为**跨数据集**校准→评估（如 HumanEval↔KodCode、MATH-500↔AIME）。

**消融**：层选择（0.15L…0.9L 与 L−1）、校准集规模（10/25/50/100%）、打分器设计（single-best-layer、ensemble 凸组合、transformer-final、transformer-last-10、transformer-special）、rollout 预算 N=4/8/12/16、混合域校准与 LLM 路由的两阶段域自适应、同分布 vs 跨分布。
AI.result:
**RQ1（对比置信度启发式）**：SCaTR 在所有设置上匹配或超越最强置信度基线，数学最高 +9.1%（Qwen-30B-A3B，AIME 上 42.4 vs 33.3）、代码最高 +6.1%（OLMo-2-7B，KodCode 上 33.1 vs 27.0）；GPT-OSS-20B AIME→MATH-500 上关闭了 oracle 差距的 12.9%，Qwen-30B AIME→MATH-500 达 76.8%。所有置信度/不确定性指标（均值置信度、中位数、方差、概率差、Shannon 熵）及其不同聚合方式（Full/Tail/Group Lowest/Bottom-10%）的表现都接近随机选择，且彼此无一致优劣。SCaTR-WMV 在部分数学设置进一步提升，与答案聚合互补。

**RQ2（对比强学习式验证器）**：vs ReasonFlux-1.5B（Qwen2.5-14B rollout）：AIME24 18.5 vs 17.8、AIME25 21.6 vs 14.4（+7.2）、MATH-500 80.4 vs 79.2，而 SCaTR 仅用 1K OpenThoughts 样本（500 数学+500 代码），ReasonFlux 用全量 114K；对 ReasonFlux-7B 在 AIME24/25 上在 1 个标准差内、MATH-500 落后约 5%。参数与速度：SCaTR 打分器约 1.7M–6.7M 参数，PRM 为 1.5B（少至多 1000×），推理延迟 0.1–0.3 ms vs 25–190 ms（加速至多约 1000×）；编码任务上 SCaTR 精度常高于 PRM（GPT-OSS-20B HumanEval +3.3、KodCode +4.2；Qwen-1.7B KodCode +2.6），数学最高 +7.8%（Qwen-1.7B AIME）。vs LoRA：GPT-OSS-20B AIME 0.95 vs 0.95、KodCode 0.93 vs 0.92、HumanEval 0.87 vs 0.85，训练 FLOPs 少 3 个数量级以上（如 MATH-500 从 1.085×10^5 降至 7.4 TFLOPs）、训练时间少至多 150×、推理加速至多 3500×，但个别设置（Qwen-1.7B、OLMo-2 的 AIME/HumanEval）精度低于 LoRA 约 1–5 点。

**RQ3（消融）**：层选择上 0.6L–L−1 表现相近且倒数第二层方差最低，故为稳健默认；校准集规模上 10%→100% 精度单调提升（GPT-OSS HumanEval→KodCode 78.8→86.8）并降低方差，KodCode（1000 题）上提前饱和；打分器设计上五种更复杂变体与 SCaTR 基本持平（差值多在 ±1 内），但训练/推理成本更高，故不支持堆复杂度；随 N 增大，编码任务上 SCaTR 持续优于置信度/PRM/LoRA，数学任务上部分小模型出现平台期甚至下降；混合域校准与两阶段 LLM 路由（路由准确率 100%）结果几乎相同，说明单域校准已足够。
AI.conclusion: SCaTR 证明了一个简单而稳健的设计点：**「基座模型倒数第二层最后 token 的隐藏表示 + 小校准集上训练的浅层 MLP」即可作为高质量、可校准的 Best-of-N 打分信号**，在准确率与效率上均优于基于 token 概率的置信度启发式，并与需大规模数据/算力的 PRM、LoRA 方案打成平手甚至更优，同时把推理打分开销压到亚毫秒级（0.1–0.3 ms）。其核心价值在于「模型专属校准」带来的高数据效率：仅数百至 1K 标注 rollout 即可超过用 114K 样本训练的 PRM。作者主张这是一种实用的混合部署范式：轻量 MLP 处理常规/低歧义问题，大型 PRM 保留给确实需要更强推理容量的困难样本。**局限**：① 需访问中间隐藏状态，仅适用于开源权重模型，无法用于闭源 API 模型；② 仅评测单轮推理任务，多轮交互中内部状态演化的问题未解决；③ 表征被简化为单个汇总向量（最后非填充 token），未探索 token 级状态、注意力模式、层间动态等更丰富的内部信号（作者认为在更长、更复杂的推理任务上可能有提升空间）；④ 需要为每个模型单独训练校准器，存在模型专属成本；⑤ 数学小模型上 rollout 增多时收益饱和/退化，跨域（math↔code）迁移虽可行但域内训练仍一致更强（该现象在 LoRA 对照实验中更明显）。

title: Scaling Test-Time Compute for Agentic Coding
summary: Test-time scaling has become a powerful way to improve large language models. However, existing methods are best suited to short, bounded outputs that can be directly compared, ranked or refined. Long-horizon coding agents violate this premise: each attempt produces an extended trajectory of actions, observations, errors, and partial progress taken by the agent. In this setting, the main challenge is no longer generating more attempts, but representing prior experience in a form that can be effectively selected from and reused. We propose a test-time scaling framework for agentic coding based on compact representations of rollout trajectories. Our framework converts each rollout into a structured summary that preserves its salient hypotheses, progress, and failure modes while discarding low-signal trace details. This representation enables two complementary forms of inference-time scaling. For parallel scaling, we introduce Recursive Tournament Voting (RTV), which recursively narrows a population of rollout summaries through small-group comparisons. For sequential scaling, we adapt Parallel-Distill-Refine (PDR) to the agentic setting by conditioning new rollouts on summaries distilled from prior attempts. Our method consistently improves the performance of frontier coding agents across SWE-Bench Verified and Terminal-Bench v2.0. For example, by using our method Claude-4.5-Opus improves from 70.9% to 77.6% on SWE-Bench Verified (mini-SWE-agent) and 46.9% to 59.1% on Terminal-Bench v2.0 (Terminus 1). Our results suggest that test-time scaling for long-horizon agents is fundamentally a problem of representation, selection, and reuse.

title: Migrant Voices, Local News: Insights on Bridging Community Needs with Media Content
comment: David Alonso del Barrio, Paula Dolores Rescala, Victor Bros, Daniel Gatica-Perez| ACM 2026. This is the author's version of the work. It is posted here for your personal use. Not for redistribution. The definitive Version of Record will be published in IMX'26 ACM International Conference on Interactive Media Experiences https://doi.org/10.1145/3788851.3805011
summary: Research shows news consumption differs across demographics, yet little is known about non-mainstream audiences, especially in relation to local media. Our study addresses this gap by examining how French-speaking migrants in a mid-size European city engage with local news, and whether their needs are reflected in coverage. Eight community members participated in focus groups, whose insights guided the selection of natural language processing methods (topic modeling, information retrieval, sentiment analysis, and readability) applied to over 2000 hyper-local news articles. Results showed that while articles frequently covered local events, gaps remained in topics important to participants. Sentiment analysis revealed a generally positive tone, and readability measures indicated an intermediate-advanced French level, raising questions about accessibility for integration. Our work contributes to bridging the gap between local news platforms' content and diverse readers' needs, and could inform local media organizations about opportunities to expand their current news story coverage to appeal to more diverse audiences.

title: SAVE: A Generalizable Framework for Multi-Condition Single-Cell Generation with Gene Block Attention
summary: Modeling single-cell gene expression across diverse biological and technical conditions is crucial for characterizing cellular states and simulating unseen scenarios. Existing methods often treat genes as independent tokens, overlooking their high-level biological relationships and leading to poor performance. We introduce SAVE, a unified generative framework based on conditional Transformers for multi-condition single-cell modeling. SAVE leverages a coarse-grained representation by grouping semantically related genes into blocks, capturing higher-order dependencies among gene modules. A Flow Matching mechanism and condition-masking strategy further enhance flexible simulation and enable generalization to unseen condition combinations. We evaluate SAVE on a range of benchmarks, including conditional generation, batch effect correction, and perturbation prediction. SAVE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in generation fidelity and extrapolative generalization, especially in low-resource or combinatorially held-out settings. Overall, SAVE offers a scalable and generalizable solution for modeling complex single-cell data, with broad utility in virtual cell synthesis and biological interpretation. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/fdu-wangfeilab/sc-save

title: User Experiences with MPI RMA and ULFM in a Resilient Key-Value Store Implementation
summary:
As hardware failures such as node losses become increasingly common, MPI programmers may want to save vulnerable data in a resilient store. While third-party storage solutions such as Redis or the Hazelcast IMap exist, a tailored, MPI-based store may be easier to integrate and can be optimized for particular application needs.
  This paper considers the implementation of such a store, which is intended as a component in a resilient task-based runtime system written in MPI. The store holds redundant data copies as key-value pairs in the main memories of multiple processes. Since store access operations, such as reads and writes, are naturally one-sided, we implemented the store with passive target MPI RMA functions. Process aborts are detected with the user-level failure mitigation (ULFM) extension of Open MPI. After failures, the program recovers on the surviving processes and continues with the intact data copies.
  Our implementation proved difficult, since several proposed ULFM functionalities for RMA have not yet been implemented. Even assuming their existence, we think that the programming task could be simplified. This paper describes our experiences, lists functionalities that we missed, and explains a workaround that we adopted in our implementation.

title: SafeAgent: A Runtime Protection Architecture for Agentic Systems
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are vulnerable to prompt-injection attacks that propagate through multi-step workflows, tool interactions, and persistent context, making input-output filtering alone insufficient for reliable protection. This paper presents SafeAgent, a runtime security architecture that treats agent safety as a stateful decision problem over evolving interaction trajectories. The proposed design separates execution governance from semantic risk reasoning through two coordinated components: a runtime controller that mediates actions around the agent loop and a context-aware decision core that operates over persistent session state. The core is formalized as a context-aware advanced machine intelligence and instantiated through operators for risk encoding, utility-cost evaluation, consequence modeling, policy arbitration, and state synchronization. Experiments on Agent Security Bench (ASB) and InjecAgent show that SafeAgent consistently improves robustness over baseline and text-level guardrail methods while maintaining competitive benign-task performance. Ablation studies further show that recovery confidence and policy weighting determine distinct safety-utility operating points.

title: The Reliance Negotiation Framework: A Dynamic Process Model of Student LLM Engagement in Academic Writing
summary: Student engagement with large language models (LLMs) in academic writing is not a stable trait, an adoption decision, or a competency level; it is a continuously negotiated process that existing frameworks cannot adequately theorize. Typological models provide categories without mechanisms; technology acceptance models explain adoption but not post-adoption quality; AI literacy frameworks treat competency as a static predictor rather than a live input. None accounts for within-student variability across tasks, the developmental paradox whereby experience produces habituation rather than sophistication, or principled non-use as a form of ethical reasoning. This article introduces the Reliance Negotiation Framework (RNF), developed from a sequential explanatory mixed-methods study of 382 undergraduates at a public minority-serving institution in the United States (survey, N = 382; 14 semi-structured interviews; three qualitative survey strands; 1,435 coded instances). The RNF reconceptualizes LLM reliance as an ongoing negotiation among four concurrent inputs (perceived benefits, perceived risks, ethical commitments, and situational demands) with outputs that recursively modify subsequent decisions. A Two-Model Architecture accommodates the 13.0% of participants whose categorical ethical commitments foreclose negotiation entirely. The framework generates four falsifiable predictions with implications for AI literacy pedagogy, academic integrity policy, and equity-centered practice at minority-serving institutions.

title: RLM-on-KG: Heuristics First, LLMs When Needed: Adaptive Retrieval Control over Mention Graphs for Scattered Evidence
comment: Preprint. 32 pages, 9 figures. Code and data available at the project repository
summary: When does an LLM controller outperform rule-based traversal for knowledge graph exploration? We study this question through RLM-on-KG, a retrieval system that treats an LLM as an autonomous navigator over an RDF-encoded mention graph for grounded question answering. Unlike GraphRAG pipelines that rely on offline LLM indexing, RLM-on-KG performs entity-first, multi-hop exploration at query time using deterministic graph construction and a fixed tool set. Our central finding is a conditional advantage: the value of LLM control depends on evidence scatter and tool-calling sophistication. The paper's core claim is LLM control versus heuristic traversal, not a generic win over GraphRAG. On GraphRAG-Bench Novel (519 questions), Gemini 2.0 Flash achieves +2.47 pp F1 over a rule-based heuristic baseline (p < 0.0001), but only +0.16 pp over a GraphRAG-local variant (not significant). With a stronger controller, Claude Haiku 4.5, the gain over heuristic grows to +4.37 pp (p < 0.001) and extends to a +2.42 pp significant improvement over GraphRAG-local (p < 0.001). The gain is largest when gold evidence is scattered across 6-10 chunks (+3.21 pp) and smallest for concentrated evidence (+1.85 pp). Cross-scale validation on MuSiQue confirms that the LLM-over-heuristic advantage transfers, with expected attenuation on smaller per-question graphs. The core architectural insight is the separation of candidate discovery from ranking: the LLM adds value through exploration breadth, while final evidence selection is best handled by pure vector re-ranking. Beyond retrieval, exploration traces provide a proposed stress-test harness for structured data quality, yielding diagnostics for coverage, connectivity, provenance, and queryability.

title: Towards Reliable Testing of Machine Unlearning
summary: Machine learning components are now central to AI-infused software systems, from recommendations and code assistants to clinical decision support. As regulations and governance frameworks increasingly require deleting sensitive data from deployed models, machine unlearning is emerging as a practical alternative to full retraining. However, unlearning introduces a software quality-assurance challenge: under realistic deployment constraints and imperfect oracles, how can we test that a model no longer relies on targeted information? This paper frames unlearning testing as a first-class software engineering problem. We argue that practical unlearning tests must provide (i) thorough coverage over proxy and mediated influence pathways, (ii) debuggable diagnostics that localize where leakage persists, (iii) cost-effective regression-style execution under query budgets, and (iv) black-box applicability for API-deployed models. We outline a causal, pathway-centric perspective, causal fuzzing, that generates budgeted interventions to estimate residual direct and indirect effects and produce actionable "leakage reports". Proof-of-concept results illustrate that standard attribution checks can miss residual influence due to proxy pathways, cancellation effects, and subgroup masking, motivating causal testing as a promising direction for unlearning testing.

title: Understanding Tool-Augmented Agents for Lean Formalization: A Factorial Analysis
summary: Automatic translation of natural language mathematics into faithful Lean 4 code is hindered by the fundamental dissonance between informal set-theoretic intuition and strict formal type theory. This gap often causes LLMs to hallucinate non-existent library definitions, resulting in code that fails to compile or lacks semantic fidelity. In this work, we investigate the effectiveness of tool-augmented agents for this task through a systematic factorial analysis of three distinct tool categories: Fine-tuned Model Querying (accessing expert drafts), Knowledge Search (retrieving symbol definitions), and Compiler Feedback (verifying code via a Lean REPL). We first benchmark the agent against one-shot baselines, demonstrating large gains in both compilation success and semantic equivalence. We then use the factorial decomposition to quantify the impact of each category, isolating the marginal contribution of each tool type to overall performance.

title: IYKYK (But AI Doesn't): Automated Content Moderation Does Not Capture Communities' Heterogeneous Attitudes Towards Reclaimed Language
summary: Reclaimed slur usage is a common and meaningful practice online for many marginalized communities. It serves as a source of solidarity, identity, and shared experience. However, contemporary automated and AI-based moderation tools for online content largely fail to distinguish between reclaimed and hateful uses of slurs, resulting in the suppression of marginalized voices. In this work, we use quantitative and qualitative methods to examine the attitudes of social media users in LGBTQIA+, Black, and women communities around reclaimed slurs targeting our focus groups including the f-word, n-word, and b-word. With social media users from these communities, we collect and analyze an annotated online slur usage corpus. The corpus includes annotators' perceptions of whether an online text containing a slur should be flagged as hate speech, as well as contextual features of the slur usage. Across all communities and annotation questions, we observe low inter-annotator agreement, indicating substantial disagreement among in-group annotators. This is compounded by the fact that, absent clear contextual signals of identity and intent, even in-group members may disagree on how to interpret reclaimed slur usage online. Semi-structured interviews with annotators suggest that differences in lived experience and personal history contribute to this variation as well. We find poor alignment between annotator judgments and automated hate speech assessments produced by Perspective API. We further observe that certain features of a text such as whether the slur usage was derogatory and if the slur was targeted at oneself are more associated with whether annotators report the text as hate speech. Together, these findings highlight the inherent subjectivity and contextual nature of how marginalized communities interpret slurs online.

title: Introspection Adapters: Training LLMs to Report Their Learned Behaviors
summary: When model developers or users fine-tune an LLM, this can induce behaviors that are unexpected, deliberately harmful, or hard to detect. It would be far easier to audit LLMs if they could simply describe their behaviors in natural language. Here, we study a scalable approach to rapidly identify learned behaviors of many LLMs derived from a shared base LLM. Given a model $M$, our method works by finetuning models $M_i$ from $M$ with implanted behaviors $b_i$; the $(M_i, b_i)$ pairs serve as labeled training data. We then train an \emph{introspection adapter} (IA): a single LoRA adapter jointly trained across the finetunes $M_i$ to cause them to verbalize their implanted behaviors. We find that this IA induces self-description of learned behaviors even in finetunes of $M$ that were trained in very different ways from the $M_i$. For example, IAs generalize to AuditBench, achieving state-of-the-art at identifying explicitly hidden concerning behaviors. IAs can also be used to detect encrypted finetuning API attacks. They scale favorably with model size and training data diversity. Overall, our results suggest that IAs are a scalable, effective, and practically useful approach to auditing fine-tuned LLMs.

title: CAPO: Counterfactual Credit Assignment in Sequential Cooperative Teams
summary: In cooperative teams where agents act in a fixed order and share a single team reward, it is hard to know how much each agent contributed, and harder still when agents are updated one at a time because data collected earlier no longer reflects the new policies. We introduce the Sequential Aristocrat Utility (SeqAU), the unique per-agent learning signal that maximizes the individual learnability of each agent's action, extending the classical framework of Wolpert and Tumer (2002) to this sequential setting. From SeqAU we derive CAPO (Counterfactual Advantage Policy Optimization), a critic-free policy-gradient algorithm. CAPO fits a per-agent reward decomposition from group rewards and computes the per-agent advantage in closed form plus a handful of forward passes through the current policy, requiring no extra environment calls beyond the initial batch. We give analytic bias and variance bounds and validate them on a controlled sequential bandit, where CAPO's advantage over standard baselines grows with the team size. The framework is general; multi-LLM pipelines are a natural deployment target.

title: The Effects of Request Alerts on the Diversity and Visibility of Community Notes
summary: Several major social media platforms have shifted toward crowdsourced fact-checking systems like Community Notes to combat misinformation at scale. However, these systems face criticism regarding which content is scrutinized and how visible that scrutiny is. To address these concerns, X allows users to request community notes for specific posts. When sufficient requests accumulate, X displays an alert, formalizing an interface cue intended to guide contributor behavior. In this study, we examine the effectiveness of request alerts. We infer the presence of request alerts at the time each note was written and identify 318 top writers who were repeatedly exposed to these alerts. Through analyzing their contributed 54,874 English notes written with and without request alerts, we find that at the individual level, writers fact-check more diverse and more political content under alerts. Nonetheless, at the collective level, these shifts direct contributions toward the already dominant Politics and Conflict category, thereby increasing content inequality within the Community Notes ecosystem. Finally, using a mixed-effects model that controls for both writer- and topic-level random effects, we estimate that notes written under alerts are between 8.4 and 20.2 percentage points more likely to be classified as helpful and thus visible to the public, compared to non-alerted notes. This visibility gain diminishes as topics diverge further from writers' prior interests, demonstrating a pivot penalty effect. Taken together, our findings show that request alerts function as an effective interface cue that increases both topical diversity and note visibility in Community Notes.

title: HeadRank: Decoding-Free Passage Reranking via Preference-Aligned Attention Heads
summary: Decoding-free reranking methods that read relevance signals directly from LLM attention weights offer significant latency advantages over autoregressive approaches, yet suffer from attention score homogenization: middle-context documents receive near-identical scores, destroying the fine-grained distinctions required for ranking. We propose HeadRank, a framework that lifts preference optimization from discrete token space into the continuous attention domain through entropy-regularized head selection, hard adjacent-level preference pairs, and a distribution regularizer that jointly sharpen discriminability in the homogenized middle zone. Depth truncation at the deepest selected layer further reduces inference to $\mathcal{O}(1)$ forward passes. Across 14 benchmarks on three Qwen3 scales (0.6B--4B) using only 211 training queries, HeadRank consistently outperforms generative and decoding-free baselines with 100\% formatting success. At 4B, 57.4\% of relevant middle-zone documents reach the top quartile versus 14.2\% for irrelevant ones -- a 43-percentage-point selectivity gap that demonstrates the effectiveness of attention-space preference alignment for listwise reranking.

title: An Interpretable Framework Applying Protein Words to Predict Protein-Small Molecule Complementary Pairing Rules
summary: Despite the high accuracy of 'black box' deep learning models, drug discovery still relies on protein-ligand interaction principles and heuristics. To improve interpretability of protein-small molecule binding predictions, we developed the PWRules framework, which applies binding affinity data to identify privileged small molecule fragments and subsequently defines complementary pairing rules between these fragments and protein words (semantic sequence units) through an interpretability module. The resulting word-fragment rules are then ranked by the PWScore function to prioritize active compounds. Evaluations on benchmark datasets show that PWScore achieves competitive performance comparable to the physics-based model (Glide) and the deep learning model (PSICHIC) and shows broad applicability for protein targets outside the training dataset, e.g., SARS-CoV-2 main protease. Notably, PWScore captures complementary interaction information, yielding superior enrichment performance when integrated with these established methods. Structural analysis of protein-ligand complexes indicates that learned word-fragment rules are significantly enriched near ligand-binding pockets, despite training without explicit structural guidance. By extracting and applying complementary pairing rules, PWRules provides an interpretable framework for drug discovery.

title: SpecPylot: Python Specification Generation using Large Language Models
comment: Accepted in 34th ACM Joint European Software Engineering Conference and Symposium on the Foundations of Software Engineering (FSE Companion 26)
summary: Automatically generating formal specifications could reduce the effort needed to improve program correctness, but in practice, this is still challenging. Many developers avoid writing contracts by hand, which limits the use of automated verification tools. Recent large language models (LLMs) can generate specifications from code, but these specifications often fail in terms of verification. The reason is syntax errors, overly strict constraints, or mismatches with program behavior. We present SpecPylot, a Python tool that synthesizes executable specifications for Python programs as icontract annotations and checks them using crosshair's symbolic execution. The tool relies on LLMs to propose candidate contracts and uses crosshair to validate them. When crosshair finds a concrete counterexample, SpecPylot updates only the generated contracts and leaves the program itself untouched. In addition, the tool can produce coverage-driven pytest stubs and keep detailed execution artifacts that are useful during debugging. Overall, the evaluation indicates that SpecPylot is able to generate crosshair-compatible contracts for most programs, but it also highlights the practical limits introduced by bounded symbolic exploration and differences in LLM behavior.

title: Defragmenting Language Models: An Interpretability-based Approach for Vocabulary Expansion
summary: All languages are equal; when it comes to tokenization, some are more equal than others. Tokens are the hidden currency that dictate the cost and latency of access to contemporary LLMs. However, many languages written in non-Latin scripts observe a poor exchange rate: LLMs take several multiples of tokens to encode the same information in many languages as they do for English. Our analysis reveals that this issue, known as 'token over-fragmentation', persists in modern open-weight LLMs. The standard remedy is vocabulary expansion that adds target language items missing from the model's vocabulary. In this work, we comprehensively study and advance interpretability-based vocabulary expansion, a new research direction. We focus on two core decisions in the vocabulary expansion process: What items should we add? and How should we initialize their corresponding input and output embeddings? First, we question the conventional use of frequency-based methods to choose candidate vocabulary items to add (a decision long treated as settled), and show that interpretability-based methods offer a superior performance-token efficiency trade-off. Next, we strengthen the case for interpretability-based embedding initialization by showing large gains (~20 pts) over baseline initialization methods for several languages written in non-Latin scripts. We identify the phenomenon of "subword detokenization" where models progressively merge fragmented subword tokens into larger subwords across layers. Grounded in our analysis of this phenomenon, we propose FragMend to further push the efficiency ceiling of interpretability-based expansion. We validate the effectiveness of FragMend through comparison against strong baselines and we present extensive analysis of its design choices.

title: The Cognitive Penalty: Ablating System 1 and System 2 Reasoning in Edge-Native SLMs for Decentralized Consensus
comment: Working paper. 14 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Code and dataset: https://github.com/smarizvi110/sentinel-bench
summary:
Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs) are inclined explore Small Language Models (SLMs) as edge-native constitutional firewalls to vet proposals and mitigate semantic social engineering. While scaling inference-time compute (System 2) enhances formal logic, its efficacy in highly adversarial, cryptoeconomic governance environments remains underexplored. To address this, we introduce Sentinel-Bench, an 840-inference empirical framework executing a strict intra-model ablation on Qwen-3.5-9B. By toggling latent reasoning across frozen weights, we isolate the impact of inference-time compute against an adversarial Optimism DAO dataset. Our findings reveal a severe compute-accuracy inversion. The autoregressive baseline (System 1) achieved 100% adversarial robustness, 100% juridical consistency, and state finality in under 13 seconds. Conversely, System 2 reasoning introduced catastrophic instability, fundamentally driven by a 26.7% Reasoning Non-Convergence (cognitive collapse) rate. This collapse degraded trial-to-trial consensus stability to 72.6% and imposed a 17x latency overhead, introducing critical vulnerabilities to Governance Extractable Value (GEV) and hardware centralization. While rare (1.5% of adversarial trials), we empirically captured "Reasoning-Induced Sycophancy," where the model generated significantly longer internal monologues (averaging 25,750 characters) to rationalize failing the adversarial trap. We conclude that for edge-native SLMs operating under Byzantine Fault Tolerance (BFT) constraints, System 1 parameterized intuition is structurally and economically superior to System 2 iterative deliberation for decentralized consensus.

title: TacticGen: Grounding Adaptable and Scalable Generation of Football Tactics
summary: Success in association football relies on both individual skill and coordinated tactics. While recent advancements in spatio-temporal data and deep learning have enabled predictive analyses like trajectory forecasting, the development of tactical design remains limited. Bridging this gap is essential, as prediction reveals what is likely to occur, whereas tactic generation determines what should occur to achieve strategic objectives. In this work, we present TacticGen, a generative model for adaptable and scalable tactic generation. TacticGen formulates tactics as sequences of multi-agent movements and interactions conditioned on the game context. It employs a multi-agent diffusion transformer with agent-wise self-attention and context-aware cross-attention to capture cooperative and competitive dynamics among players and the ball. Trained with over 3.3 million events and 100 million tracking frames from top-tier leagues, TacticGen achieves state-of-the-art precision in predicting player trajectories. Building on it, TacticGen enables adaptable tactic generation tailored to diverse inference-time objectives through classifier guidance mechanism, specified via rules, natural language, or neural models. Its modeling performance is also inherently scalable. A case study with football experts confirms that TacticGen generates realistic, strategically valuable tactics, demonstrating its practical utility for tactical planning in professional football. The project page is available at: https://shengxu.net/TacticGen/.

title: All Public Voices Are Equal, But Are Some More Equal Than Others to LLMs?
summary: Federal agencies are increasingly deploying large language models (LLMs) to process public comments submitted during notice-and-comment rulemaking, the primary mechanism through which citizens influence federal regulation. Whether these systems treat all public input equally remains largely untested. Using a counterfactual design, we held comment content constant and varied only the commenter's demographic attribution -- race, gender, and socioeconomic status -- to test whether eight LLMs available for federal use produce differential summaries of identical comments. We processed 182 public comments across 32 identity conditions, generating over 106,000 summaries. Occupation was the only identity signal to produce consistent differential treatment: the same comment attributed to a street vendor, compared to a financial analyst, received a summary that preserved less of the original meaning, used simpler language, and shifted emotional tone. This pattern held across all names, prompts, models, and regulatory contexts tested. Race effects were inconsistent and appeared driven by specific name tokens rather than racial categories; gender effects were absent. Writing quality predicted summarization outcomes through argument substance rather than surface mechanics; experimentally injected spelling and grammar errors had negligible effects. The magnitude of occupation-based differential treatment varied by model provider, meaning that selecting a model implicitly selects a level of fairness -- a dimension that current procurement frameworks such as FedRAMP do not evaluate. These findings suggest that socioeconomic signals warrant attention in AI fairness assessments for government information systems, and that fairness benchmarks could be incorporated into existing federal IT procurement processes.

title: HORIZON: A Benchmark for In-the-wild User Behaviour Modeling
summary: User behavior in the real world is diverse, cross-domain, and spans long time horizons. Existing user modeling benchmarks however remain narrow, focusing mainly on short sessions and next-item prediction within a single domain. Such limitations hinder progress toward robust and generalizable user models. We present HORIZON, a new benchmark that reformulates user modeling along three axes i.e. dataset, task, and evaluation. Built from a large-scale, cross-domain reformulation of Amazon Reviews, HORIZON covers 54M users and 35M items, enabling both pretraining and realistic evaluation of models in heterogeneous environments. Unlike prior benchmarks, it challenges models to generalize across domains, users, and time, moving beyond standard missing-positive prediction in the same domain. We propose new tasks and evaluation setups that better reflect real-world deployment scenarios. These include temporal generalization, sequence-length variation, and modeling unseen users, with metrics designed to assess general user behavior understanding rather than isolated next-item prediction. We benchmark popular sequential recommendation architectures alongside LLM-based baselines that leverage long-term interaction histories. Our results highlight the gap between current methods and the demands of real-world user modeling, while establishing HORIZON as a foundation for research on temporally robust, cross-domain, and general-purpose user models.

title: LLM as a Tool, Not an Agent: Code-Mined Tree Transformations for Neural Architecture Search
summary: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) aims to automatically discover high-performing deep neural network (DNN) architectures. However, conventional algorithm-driven NAS relies on carefully hand-crafted search spaces to ensure executability, which restricts open-ended exploration. Recent coding-based agentic approaches using large language models (LLMs) reduce manual design, but current LLMs struggle to reliably generate complex, valid architectures, and their proposals are often biased toward a narrow set of patterns observed in their training data. To bridge reliable algorithmic search with powerful LLM assistance, we propose LLMasTool, a hierarchical tree-based NAS framework for stable and open-ended model evolution. Our method automatically extracts reusable modules from arbitrary source code and represents full architectures as hierarchical trees, enabling evolution through reliable tree transformations rather than code generation. At each evolution step, coarse-level planning is governed by a diversity-guided algorithm that leverages Bayesian modeling to improve exploration efficiency, while the LLM resolves the remaining degrees of freedom to ensure a meaningful evolutionary trajectory and an executable generated architecture. With this formulation, instead of fully agentic LLM approaches, our method explores diverse directions beyond the inherent biases in the LLM. Our method improves over existing NAS methods by 0.69, 1.83, and 2.68 points on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet16-120, demonstrating its effectiveness.

title: Certified Program Synthesis with a Multi-Modal Verifier
summary:
Certified program synthesis (aka vericoding) is the process of automatically generating a program, its formal specification, and a machine-checkable proof of their alignment from a natural-language description. Two challenges make vericoding difficult. First, specifications synthesised from natural language are often either too weak to be meaningful or too strong to be implementable, yet existing approaches lack systematic means to detect such defects. Second, the landscape of program verifiers is fragmented: each tool supports a particular reasoning mode -- auto-active (e.g., Dafny, Verus) or interactive (e.g., Coq, Lean) -- with its own trade-off between automation and expressivity. This forces every synthesis methodology to be tailored to a single verification paradigm, limiting the class of tasks it can handle effectively.
  We overcome both challenges by structuring the certified synthesis workflow around a multi-modal verifier -- a single tool combining dynamic validation, automated proofs, and interactive proof scripting in one foundational framework. We realise this idea in LeetProof, an agentic pipeline built on Velvet, a multi-modal verifier embedded in Lean. Multi-modality enables LeetProof to validate generated specifications via randomised property-based testing before any code is synthesised, decompose the synthesis task into sub-problems guided by verification conditions, and delegate residual proof obligations to frontier AI provers specialised for Lean. We evaluate LeetProof on benchmarks derived from prior work on certified synthesis. Our specification validation uncovers defects in existing reference benchmarks, and LeetProof's staged pipeline achieves a significantly higher rate of fully certified solutions than a single-mode baseline at the same budget -- consistently across two frontier LLM backends.

title: CBRS: Cognitive Blood Request System with Bilingual Dataset and Dual-Layer Filtering for Multi-Platform Social Streams
comment: Accepted to Findings of the ACL 2026
summary: Urgent blood donation seeking posts and messages on social media often go unnoticed due to the overwhelming volume of daily communications. Traditional app-based systems, reliant on manual input, struggle to reach users in low-resource settings, delaying critical responses. To address this, we introduce the Cognitive Blood Request System (CBRS), a multi-platform framework that efficiently filters and parses blood donation requests from social media streams using a cost-efficient dual-layered architecture. To do so, we curate a novel dataset of 11K parsed blood donation request messages in Bengali, English, and transliterated Bengali, capturing the linguistic diversity of real social media communications. The inclusion of adversarial negatives further enhances the robustness of our model. CBRS achieves an impressive 99% accuracy and precision in filtering, surpassing benchmark methods. In the parsing task, our LoRA finetuned Llama-3.2-3B model achieves 92% zero-shot accuracy, surpassing the base model by 41.54% and exceeding the few-shot performance of GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-2.0-Flash, and other LLMs, while resulting in a 35X reduction in input token usage. This work lays a robust foundation for scalable, inclusive information extraction in time-sensitive, object-focused tasks. Our code, dataset, and trained models are publicly available at [https://github.com/aaniksahaa/CBRS](https://github.com/aaniksahaa/CBRS).

title: The CTLNet for Shanghai Composite Index Prediction
summary: Shanghai Composite Index prediction has become a hot issue for many investors and academic researchers. Deep learning models are widely applied in multivariate time series forecasting, including recurrent neural networks (RNN), convolutional neural networks (CNN), and transformers. Specifically, the Transformer encoder, with its unique attention mechanism and parallel processing capabilities, has become an important tool in time series prediction, and has an advantage in dealing with long sequence dependencies and multivariate data correlations. Drawing on the strengths of various models, we propose the CNN-Transformer-LSTM Networks (CTLNet). This paper explores the application of CTLNet for Shanghai Composite Index prediction and the comparative experiments show that the proposed model outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

title: Hive: A Multi-Agent Infrastructure for Algorithm- and Task-Level Scaling
summary:
Large language models are increasingly deployed as complex agentic systems that scale with task complexity. While prior work has extensively explored model- and system-level scaling, algorithm- and task-level scaling remain largely unaddressed, constraining the full potential of agentic systems. At the algorithm level, allocating additional inference-time computation can enhance workflow capacity but introduces cross-path redundancy: overlapping computations across multiple reasoning branches. At the task level, complex tasks can be decomposed into subproblems and delegated across multiple agents for improved scalability and parallelism. However, existing infrastructures' scheduling is unaware of the existence of multiple agents, missing opportunities to optimize resource allocation.
  We propose Hive, a multi-agent infrastructure that enables algorithm- and task-level scaling. Hive features a description frontend that captures per-agent behavior and supports test-time scaling algorithms. Leveraging this specification, our backend introduces two key mechanisms: Logits Cache that reuses intermediate logits across redundant sampling paths to mitigate cross-path redundancy at the algorithm level, and Agent-Aware Scheduling that efficiently allocates compute and KV-cache resources according to agent contributions at the task level. Experiments show that Logits Cache achieves an average speedup of $1.11\times$-$1.76\times$ for re-sampling, and Agent-Aware Scheduling reduces the hotspot miss rate by $33\%$-$51\%$.
